# Editing this README

When you're ready to make this README your own, just edit this file and use the handy template below (or feel free to structure it however you want - this is just a starting point!). Thank you to [makeareadme.com](https://www.makeareadme.com/) for this template.

## Suggestions for a good README
Every project is different, so consider which of these sections apply to yours. The sections used in the template are suggestions for most open source projects. Also keep in mind that while a README can be too long and detailed, too long is better than too short. If you think your README is too long, consider utilizing another form of documentation rather than cutting out information.

## Name
Choose a self-explaining name for your project.

## Description
Let people know what your project can do specifically. Provide context and add a link to any reference visitors might be unfamiliar with. A list of Features or a Background subsection can also be added here. If there are alternatives to your project, this is a good place to list differentiating factors.

## Badges
On some READMEs, you may see small images that convey metadata, such as whether or not all the tests are passing for the project. You can use Shields to add some to your README. Many services also have instructions for adding a badge.

## Visuals
Depending on what you are making, it can be a good idea to include screenshots or even a video (you'll frequently see GIFs rather than actual videos). Tools like ttygif can help, but check out Asciinema for a more sophisticated method.

## Installation
Within a particular ecosystem, there may be a common way of installing things, such as using Yarn, NuGet, or Homebrew. However, consider the possibility that whoever is reading your README is a novice and would like more guidance. Listing specific steps helps remove ambiguity and gets people to using your project as quickly as possible. If it only runs in a specific context like a particular programming language version or operating system or has dependencies that have to be installed manually, also add a Requirements subsection.

## Usage
Use examples liberally, and show the expected output if you can. It's helpful to have inline the smallest example of usage that you can demonstrate, while providing links to more sophisticated examples if they are too long to reasonably include in the README.

## Support
Tell people where they can go to for help. It can be any combination of an issue tracker, a chat room, an email address, etc.

## Roadmap
If you have ideas for releases in the future, it is a good idea to list them in the README.

## Contributing
State if you are open to contributions and what your requirements are for accepting them.

For people who want to make changes to your project, it's helpful to have some documentation on how to get started. Perhaps there is a script that they should run or some environment variables that they need to set. Make these steps explicit. These instructions could also be useful to your future self.

You can also document commands to lint the code or run tests. These steps help to ensure high code quality and reduce the likelihood that the changes inadvertently break something. Having instructions for running tests is especially helpful if it requires external setup, such as starting a Selenium server for testing in a browser.

## Authors and acknowledgment
Show your appreciation to those who have contributed to the project.

## License
For open source projects, say how it is licensed.

## Project status
If you have run out of energy or time for your project, put a note at the top of the README saying that development has slowed down or stopped completely. Someone may choose to fork your project or volunteer to step in as a maintainer or owner, allowing your project to keep going. You can also make an explicit request for maintainers.

2. Architectural Patterns

Clean Architecture (Layered)

  • Domain Layer: Business rules and entities (no dependencies)
  • Application Layer: Business logic, services, use cases with MediatR
  • Infrastructure Layer: Database, external services, repositories, Hangfire jobs
  • Presentation Layer: Controllers, middleware, validations

CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)

  • Commands for write operations (sync jobs):
    • SyncHoaDonBatchCommand
    • SyncThanhToanBatchCommand
    • SyncKhachHangBatchCommand
    • etc.
  • Handlers process commands via MediatR
  • Queries for read operations handled directly by services

Repository Pattern

  • Generic repository base class (GenericRepository.cs)
  • Specific repositories per entity (UserRepository, KhachHangRepository, HoaDonRepository, etc.)
  • Unit of Work pattern (IUnitOfWork, UnitOfWork) manages all repositories and transactions

Dependency Injection

  • Service registration in ConfigureServices methods
  • Extensions: AddApplicationService, AddInfrastructuresService, AddWebAPIService, AddHangfireServices

3. Controllers Organization

12 API Controllers following REST conventions:

  • AdminController - Administration functions
  • AuthController - Authentication/Authorization
  • CustomerController - Customer operations (list, detail, filter)
  • CustomerDashboardController - Customer reports & analytics (27KB largest)
  • CustomerCutoffController - Water cutoff management
  • CustomerDebtController - Debt tracking
  • CustomerReopenController - Water reopening
  • DeviceController - Device version checking
  • HomeController - Base endpoints
  • ReportController - Business reports
  • SharedController - Shared endpoints
  • Base Routes: Prefixed with /api (configurable in appsettings)
  • Authorization: Bearer token via JWT (custom CustomAuthMiddleware)

4. Application Configuration

Program.cs Flow:

  1. Serilog logging setup (daily rolling files in /Logs)
  2. Load AppSettings from appsettings.json
  3. Call extension methods: ConfigureServices() → ConfigurePipelineAsync()
  4. Application startup

AppSettings Structure:

- AppConfigs: AppName, AppUrl, ApiPrefix, SubAppPrefix, UseInMemoryDatabase, CommandTimeout
- HangfireConfig: UseHangfire, Worker count, Authentication
- ConnectionStrings: DefaultConnection, JobConnection, DocSoNB, Billing, NhaBeReport
- Identity: JWT keys, Issuer, Audience, Token expiry times, HTTPS validation
- ExternalSystem: NhaBe integration endpoints

Middleware Pipeline:

  1. PathBase (optional sub-app prefix)
  2. GlobalExceptionMiddleware - Unified error handling
  3. LoggingMiddleware - Request/response logging
  4. PerformanceMiddleware - Request timing
  5. Authentication & Authorization
  6. CustomAuthMiddleware - Bearer token validation
  7. CORS (Allow all origins)
  8. Swagger & Hangfire Dashboard (protected)

5. Database & Entity Context

ApplicationDbContext

  • Framework: Entity Framework Core 8.0
  • Database: SQL Server (configurable for in-memory testing)
  • Retry Policy: 3 retries with 10-second delay
  • Logging: Sensitive data logging enabled for development

Entity Types (30+ DbSets):

  • Core: NhanVien (Employee), ChucVu (Position), PhongBan (Department), KhachHang (Customer)
  • Billing: HoaDon (Invoice), ThanhToan (Payment)
  • Operations: DongNuoc (Water Cutoff), TroNgai (Obstacles), MoNuoc (Reopen)
  • Logs: LichSuHoatDong (Activity Log), KhachHangLog, LogHoatDong
  • Permissions: PQ* entities (Permissions, Roles, User-Role mappings)
  • Reports: BillingReportResult, PaymentHistoryResult, etc. (no-key entities for views)

Configuration

  • FluentAPI mappings via 37 Configuration classes in Configurations/ folder
  • Fluent Validation for DTOs

6. Custom Middleware & Filters

Middleware (4 implementations):

  1. GlobalExceptionMiddleware - Catches all exceptions, returns standardized BaseResponse<T> with error codes
  2. CustomAuthMiddleware - Validates Bearer tokens, sets User.Principal
  3. LoggingMiddleware - Logs request/response details
  4. PerformanceMiddleware - Measures request execution time

Filters & Validators:

  • ValidateModelFilter - Validates model state per request
  • FluentValidation - Input validation (supports automatic swagger docs)
  • GlobalRoutePrefixConvention - Adds /api prefix to all routes

7. Background Jobs (Hangfire)

Configuration:

  • Storage: SQL Server (JobConnection string)
  • Workers: Configurable (default 20)
  • Retry: Disabled (0 attempts)
  • Authentication: Optional (admin login required for dashboard)

Registered Jobs:

  1. SyncHoaDonJob - Invoice synchronization (batch executor pattern)
  2. SyncThanhToanJob - Payment synchronization
  3. SyncEmployeesJob - Employee data sync
  4. SyncKhachHangJob - Customer data sync
  5. SyncPhanCongNhanVienJob - Employee assignment sync
  6. SyncPhanCongToJob - Team assignment sync
  7. SyncThanhToanHuyJob - Payment cancellation sync
  8. BaoCaoTonThuJob - Revenue reports

Job Pattern:

  • Each job implements Run(CancellationToken) method
  • Batch executors for bulk data processing
  • MediatR CQRS commands for data synchronization
  • Frequency defined in database JobDefinition table

8. Key Features

Authentication & Authorization

  • JWT Bearer tokens with customizable expiry
  • Refresh token support (separate expiry time)
  • Role-based access control (Admin, Staff roles)
  • External system integration (NhaBe API)

Services (Application Layer)

  • AuthService, TokenService - Authentication
  • CustomerService, CustomerDashboardService - Customer management
  • CustomerDebtService, CustomerCutoffService, CustomerReopenService
  • ReportService - Business analytics
  • NhaBeService - External system integration
  • ActivityLogService - Action logging
  • SyncJobService - Job coordination

Data Access

  • EF Core for ORM operations
  • Dapper context for raw SQL queries (optimized performance)
  • Repository pattern with generic base
  • Unit of Work for transaction management

API Documentation

  • Swagger/OpenAPI integration
  • XML comments from codebase
  • FluentValidation rule visualization
  • Security scheme (Bearer JWT) documentation

9. Key Dependencies

  • MediatR 12.0 - CQRS command/query bus
  • FluentValidation 11.11 - Input validation
  • AutoMapper 12.0 - Object mapping
  • Hangfire 1.8.18 - Background job scheduling
  • Dapper 2.1.66 - Micro-ORM
  • Serilog 9.0 - Structured logging
  • Swashbuckle 7.0 - Swagger/OpenAPI
  • EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.4 - ORM

10. Development Notes

  • Language: Vietnamese (variable names, comments)
  • Response Format: Standardized BaseResponse<T> with error codes
  • JSON Naming: Snake_case lowercase (JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower)
  • Error Handling: Global middleware catches all exceptions
  • Logging: Daily rolling file logs in /Logs directory
  • Multi-tenancy: Optional sub-app prefix support
  • Testing: In-memory database support for unit tests
  • Localization: LocalizationService for multi-language support

This is a well-structured, enterprise-grade .NET 8 API following Clean Architecture principles with clear separation of concerns, comprehensive logging, global error handling, and background job processing capabilities.

using Serilog;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

// Tạo thư mục Logs nếu chưa có
var logPath = Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "Logs");
Directory.CreateDirectory(logPath);

// Cấu hình Serilog để log ra file theo ngày
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .WriteTo.File(
        path: Path.Combine(logPath, "log-.txt"),
        rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
        outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{Level}] {Message}{NewLine}{Exception}"
    )
    .CreateLogger();

// <summary>
// Điểm khởi đầu của ứng dụng WaterBilling. Thiết lập cấu hình, đăng ký dịch vụ và khởi động pipeline.
// </summary>
var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
builder.Host.UseSerilog(); //Phải sau CreateBuilder

// <summary>
// Tải thông tin cấu hình ứng dụng từ appsettings.json hoặc môi trường.
// Ném ngoại lệ nếu không tìm thấy cấu hình.
// </summary>
var configuration = builder.Configuration.Get<AppSettings>()
    ?? throw ProgramException.AppsettingNotSetException();

// <summary>
// Đăng ký cấu hình đã tải vào container để dùng trong toàn bộ ứng dụng.
// </summary>
builder.Services.AddSingleton(configuration);

// <summary>
// Gọi các phương thức mở rộng để cấu hình service và pipeline (middleware, endpoint,...) cho ứng dụng.
// </summary>
var app = await builder
    .ConfigureServices(configuration)
    .ConfigurePipelineAsync(configuration);

// <summary>
// Chạy ứng dụng.
// </summary>
await app.RunAsync();

/// Partial class Program để hỗ trợ integration test với WebApplicationFactory.
/// </summary>
public partial class Program { }

using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using Hangfire;
using Hangfire.Dashboard;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// Cung cấp các phương thức mở rộng để cấu hình dịch vụ và pipeline của ứng dụng.
/// </summary>
public static class HostingExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình các dịch vụ cho ứng dụng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">Đối tượng WebApplicationBuilder.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cài đặt ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>Đối tượng WebApplication đã được cấu hình.</returns>
    public static WebApplication ConfigureServices(this WebApplicationBuilder builder, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
        {
            options.AddPolicy("AllowSpecificOrigin",
                policy =>
                {
                    policy.AllowAnyOrigin()
                          .AllowAnyHeader()
                          .AllowAnyMethod();
                });
        });
        builder.Services.AddInfrastructuresService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddApplicationService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddWebAPIService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddHangfireServices(appsettings);

        return builder.Build();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình pipeline middleware cho ứng dụng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="app">Đối tượng WebApplication.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cài đặt ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>Đối tượng WebApplication đã được cấu hình.</returns>
    public async static Task<WebApplication> ConfigurePipelineAsync(this WebApplication app, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        using var loggerFactory = LoggerFactory.Create(builder => { });
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();

        if (appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix != null && appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix.Length > 0)
        {
            app.UsePathBase($"/{appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix}");
        }

        app.UseMiddleware<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();
        app.UseMiddleware<LoggingMiddleware>();
        app.UseMiddleware<PerformanceMiddleware>();
        app.UseStaticFiles();

        app.UseAuthentication();
        app.UseMiddleware<CustomAuthMiddleware>();
        app.UseAuthorization();

        app.UseHttpsRedirection();
        app.UseCors("AllowSpecificOrigin");




        // Swagger UI
        app.UseWhen(ctx => (
            ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/swagger")), subApp =>
        {
            subApp.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
            {
                if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.IsAuthen)
                {
                    if (!ctx.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
                    {
                        ctx.Response.Redirect($"{ctx.Request.PathBase}/admin/login");
                        return;
                    }
                }

                await next();
            });
        });
        app.UseSwagger(appsettings);

        app.MapControllers();

        // Hangfire dashboard
        var hangfirePath = appsettings.HangfireConfig.Path;
        app.UseWhen(ctx => ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(hangfirePath), async sub =>
        {
            sub.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
            {
                if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.IsAuthen)
                {
                    if (!ctx.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
                    {
                        ctx.Response.Redirect($"{ctx.Request.PathBase}/admin/login");
                        return;
                    }
                }
                await next();
            });

            sub.UseHangfireDashboard(hangfirePath, new DashboardOptions
            {
                Authorization = new[] { new HangfireCookieAuthorizationFilter() }
            });
            if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.UseHangfire)
            {

                await HangfireConfiguration.RegisterJobs(app.Services);
            }
        });

        // Thêm route mặc định để hiển thị tên ứng dụng
        app.MapGet("/", () => appsettings.AppConfigs.AppName);

        return app;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Lớp xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cookie.
/// </summary>
public class HangfireCookieAuthorizationFilter : IDashboardAuthorizationFilter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cách kiểm tra cookie của người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Authorize(DashboardContext context)
    {
        var user = context.GetHttpContext().User;
        return user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true && user.IsInRole("Admin");
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// class này cần được định nghĩa ở đâu đó trong project
    /// </summary>
    public class BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter : IDashboardAuthorizationFilter
    {
        private readonly string _username;
        private readonly string _password;

        /// <summary>
        /// Khởi tạo một thể hiện của BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter với tên người dùng và mật khẩu.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="username"></param>
        /// <param name="password"></param>
        public BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter(string username, string password)
        {
            _username = username;
            _password = password;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cách kiểm tra thông tin xác thực Basic Auth.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool Authorize(DashboardContext context)
        {
            var httpContext = context.GetHttpContext();
            var header = httpContext.Request.Headers["Authorization"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header)) return Challenge(httpContext);

            if (!header.ToString().StartsWith("Basic ")) return Challenge(httpContext);

            var encodedCredentials = header.ToString().Substring("Basic ".Length).Trim();
            var credentialBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(encodedCredentials);
            var credentials = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(credentialBytes).Split(':');

            if (credentials.Length != 2) return Challenge(httpContext);

            var username = credentials[0];
            var password = credentials[1];

            if (username == _username && password == _password)
                return true;

            return Challenge(httpContext);
        }

        private bool Challenge(HttpContext httpContext)
        {
            httpContext.Response.Headers["WWW-Authenticate"] = "Basic realm=\"Hangfire Dashboard\"";
            httpContext.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized;
            return false;
        }
    }
}

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Utilities;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.SchemaFilter;
using WaterBilling.Web.Validations;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Text.Encodings.Web;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// Extension method để cấu hình MVC, JSON và Authentication.
/// </summary>
public static class MvcExtension
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thiết lập các cấu hình cho MVC, JSON serializer, FluentValidation và Authentication scheme mặc định.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">Service collection của ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <param name="appSettings">AppSettings của ứng dụng.</param>
    public static void SetupMvc(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appSettings)
    {
        services.Configure<ApiBehaviorOptions>(options => options.SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter = true);

        services.AddAuthentication(options =>
        {
            options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            options.DefaultChallengeScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
        })
        .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
        {
            options.LoginPath = $"{StringHelper.FullPrefix(appSettings)}/admin/login";
            options.AccessDeniedPath = $"{StringHelper.FullPrefix(appSettings)}/admin/login";
        })
        .AddScheme<AuthenticationSchemeOptions, DummyAuthHandler>("Custom", null);
        services.AddControllersWithViews();
        services.AddControllers(options =>
                {
                    options.Filters.Add(typeof(ValidateModelFilter));
                    options.Conventions.Insert(0, new GlobalRoutePrefixConvention(appSettings.AppConfigs.ApiPrefix));
                })
                .AddJsonOptions(options =>
                {


                    // Avoid reference loop issues
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;

                    // Use ISO 8601 format for DateTime and DateTimeOffset
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonDateTimeOffsetConverter());

                    // Handle reference loops
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
                    
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new TrimmingConverter());
                    // Price: 12.34567 → 12.35 (2 decimal places).
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new DecimalPrecisionConverter(2));
                    // JSON trả về có định dạng chuẩn với snake_case
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower;


                });
        services.AddFluentValidationAutoValidation();
        services.AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<Program>();
        // services.AddTransient<IValidatorInterceptor, ValidatorInterceptor>();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Handler xác thực giả dùng cho scheme "Custom".
/// Không thực hiện xác thực thật vì đã có CustomAuthMiddleware xử lý trước đó.
/// </summary>
public class DummyAuthHandler : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Khởi tạo một instance của <see cref="DummyAuthHandler"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">Tùy chọn cho scheme xác thực.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">Logger.</param>
    /// <param name="encoder">Encoder.</param>
    /// <param name="clock">Đồng hồ hệ thống.</param>
    [Obsolete]
    public DummyAuthHandler(
        IOptionsMonitor<AuthenticationSchemeOptions> options,
        ILoggerFactory logger,
        UrlEncoder encoder,
        ISystemClock clock) : base(options, logger, encoder, clock)
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Không thực hiện xác thực – chỉ để ASP.NET Core không lỗi khi yêu cầu scheme xác thực.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>Luôn trả về <see cref="AuthenticateResult.NoResult"/>.</returns>
    protected override Task<AuthenticateResult> HandleAuthenticateAsync()
    {
        // Không thực hiện xác thực ở đây vì đã có CustomAuthMiddleware
        return Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.NoResult());
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace WaterBilling.Application;

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình tổng thể của ứng dụng, được map từ appsettings.json.
/// </summary>
public class AppSettings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin cấu hình chung của ứng dụng, như tên, URL, v.v.
    /// </summary>
    public AppConfigs AppConfigs { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin cấu hình chung của ứng Hangfire
    /// </summary>
    public HangfireConfig HangfireConfig { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin chuỗi kết nối database.
    /// </summary>
    public ConnectionStrings ConnectionStrings { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình liên quan đến xác thực và JWT token.
    /// </summary>
    public Identity Identity { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình hệ thống bên ngoài (như NhaBe).
    /// </summary>
    public ExternalSystem ExternalSystem { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Thông tin chuỗi kết nối cơ sở dữ liệu.
/// </summary>
public class ConnectionStrings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối mặc định đến database.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string DefaultConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho Hangfire.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value></value>
    public string JobConnection { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho KinhDoanhNhabe.
    /// </summary>
    public string KinhDoanhNhabeReportConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho DocSoNB.
    /// </summary>
    public string DocSoNBConnection { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho Billing.
    /// </summary>
    public string BillingConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho NhaBe.
    /// </summary>
    public string ServiceNhaBeConnection { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình xác thực và JWT.
/// </summary>
public class Identity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Có đang chạy ở môi trường local không (ảnh hưởng đến xác thực).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public bool IsLocal { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Khóa bí mật dùng để ký JWT.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Key { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Khóa bí mật dùng để ký JWT.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string KeyRefresh { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Issuer cho token JWT (người phát hành).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Issuer { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Audience cho token JWT (người nhận hợp lệ).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Audience { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Audience cho token JWT (người nhận hợp lệ).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string AudienceRefresh { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Base domain cho scope (thường dùng khi cấu hình OpenID).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string ScopeBaseDomain { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Có bắt buộc xác thực HTTPS không.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public bool ValidateHttps { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thời gian hết hạn token (tính bằng ngày).
    /// </summary>
    public int ExpiredTime { get; set; } = 10;

    /// <summary>

    public int RefreshTokenExpiredTime { get; set; } = 10;

using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Services;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Application;

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình và đăng ký các dịch vụ trong tầng Application.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Đăng ký các service logic nghiệp vụ của ứng dụng vào DI container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">Đối tượng IServiceCollection của hệ thống.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cấu hình ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>IServiceCollection sau khi đã đăng ký dịch vụ.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        services.AddTransient<IAuthService, AuthService>();
        services.AddTransient<IUserService, UserService>();
        services.AddTransient<ITokenService, TokenService>();
        services.AddTransient<IDeviceService, DeviceService>();
        services.AddTransient<IHomeService, HomeService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerService, CustomerService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerDebtService, CustomerDebtService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerCutoffService, CustomerCutoffService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerReopenService, CustomerReopenService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerDashboardService, CustomerDashboardService>();
        services.AddTransient<IReportService, ReportService>();
        services.AddTransient<ISharedService, SharedService>();
        services.AddTransient<INhaBeService, NhaBeService>();
        services.AddTransient<IWorkService, WorkService>();
        services.AddTransient<ISyncJobService, SyncJobService>();
        services.AddTransient<IActivityLogService, ActivityLogService>();

        
        services.AddTransient<ICurrentTime, CurrentTime>();


        return services;
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.HoaDon;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.ThanhToan;

namespace WaterBilling.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Provides extension methods to configure infrastructure services for the application.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures infrastructure services such as database contexts and repositories.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection to which services will be added.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The application settings containing configuration values.</param>
    /// <returns>The updated service collection.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructuresService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings configuration)
    {
        services.AddMemoryCache();

        services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
        services.AddScoped<LocalizationService>();
        // Configure the database context based on the configuration
        if (configuration.AppConfigs.UseInMemoryDatabase)
        {
            // Use an in-memory database for development or testing
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseInMemoryDatabase("WaterBilling"));
        }
        else
        {
            // Use SQL Server with retry-on-failure for production
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseSqlServer(configuration.ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection,
                sqlOptions => sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3,
                                                              maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                                                              errorNumbersToAdd: null))
                                        .LogTo(Console.WriteLine, LogLevel.Information)
                                        .EnableSensitiveDataLogging()
             );
        }

        // 🟡 Thêm dòng sau ngay sau khi services được lấy:
        services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
        {
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>();
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>();
        });

        // Register repository and unit of work services
        services.AddScoped<IUnitOfWork, UnitOfWork>();

        // Register the Dapper context
        services.AddScoped<IDapperContext, DapperContext>();

        services.AddScoped<IJobRegistryService, JobRegistryService>();

        return services;
    }
}

namespace WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;

/// <summary>
/// DbContext chính của ứng dụng WaterBilling, quản lý truy cập dữ liệu và ánh xạ thực thể.
/// Không sử dụng hệ thống Identity mặc định của ASP.NET Core.
/// </summary>
public class ApplicationDbContext : DbContext
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Khởi tạo một instance mới của <see cref="ApplicationDbContext"/> với cấu hình tuỳ chọn.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">Tuỳ chọn DbContext được inject thông qua DI.</param>
    public ApplicationDbContext(DbContextOptions<ApplicationDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>

    public DbSet<NhanVien> NhanViens { get; set; }

    public DbSet<QuanHuyen> QuanHuyens { get; set; }

    public DbSet<PhuongXa> PhuongXas { get; set; }

    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<PQNhomQuyenChiTiet> PQNhomQuyenChiTiets { get; set; }

    /// Tập thao tác của trang trong hệ thống.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<PQThaoTac> PQThaoTacs { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tập trang trong hệ thống.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<PQTrang> PQTrangs { get; set; }

    /// Tập hệ số KCN dùng để tính toán hiệu suất thu tiền theo tỷ lệ T/C (Thực thu / Chuẩn thu trong tháng).
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<HeSoKCN> HeSoKCNs { get; set; }

     /// <summary>
    /// Tập khách hàng được phân công nhắc nợ, đóng nước.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<KhachHangIssueView> KhachHangIssueViews { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả báo cáo tiêu thụ nước, tổng nợ, hóa đơn hằng tháng và tiêu thụ hằng tháng trong 1 năm của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<CustomerWaterConsumptionReportResult> CustomerWaterReportResults { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả báo cáo thanh toán của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<BillingReportResult> BillingReportResults { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả lịch sử thanh toán của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<PaymentHistoryResult> PaymentHistoryResults { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả chi tiết lịch sử thanh toán của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<PaymentDetailResult> PaymentDetailResults { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả thông tin đóng/mở nước của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<CustomerWaterControlResult> CustomerWaterControlResults { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Tập kết quả danh sách công văn của khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    public DbSet<DocumentListResult> DocumentListResults { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gọi khi tạo mô hình cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// Áp dụng các cấu hình từ assembly hiện tại và định nghĩa quan hệ n-n giữa User và Role.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">Đối tượng ModelBuilder dùng để cấu hình các thực thể.</param>
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Tự động áp dụng tất cả các cấu hình IEntityTypeConfiguration<> từ assembly hiện tại
        builder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
        // Đánh dấu entity không có khóa chính
        builder.Entity<CustomerWaterConsumptionReportResult>().HasNoKey();
        builder.Entity<BillingReportResult>().HasNoKey();
        builder.Entity<PaymentHistoryResult>().HasNoKey();
        builder.Entity<PaymentDetailResult>().HasNoKey();
        builder.Entity<CustomerWaterControlResult>().HasNoKey();
        builder.Entity<DocumentListResult>().HasNoKey();
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using WaterBilling.Models;
using ValidationException = WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions.ValidationException;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;

/// <summary>
/// Middleware xử lý ngoại lệ toàn cục cho ứng dụng. Bắt và chuẩn hóa lỗi trả về theo định dạng <see cref="BaseResponse{T}"/>.
/// </summary>
public class GlobalExceptionMiddleware(ILoggerFactory logger) : IMiddleware
{
    private readonly ILogger _logger = logger.CreateLogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Phương thức chính được gọi trong pipeline để xử lý request và bắt các exception.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP hiện tại.</param>
    /// <param name="next">Delegate tiếp theo trong pipeline.</param>
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, RequestDelegate next)
    {
        try
        {
            await next(context);
        }
        catch (ValidationException ve)
        {
            await HandlerValidationException(context, ve);
        }
        catch (HttpException httpEx)
        {
            await HandlerHttpException(context, httpEx);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError("GlobalExceptionMiddleware: {exception}", ex);
            await HandlerException(context, ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý các ngoại lệ xác thực đầu vào (thường từ FluentValidation).
    /// Trả về danh sách lỗi chi tiết dưới dạng <see cref="BaseResponse{T}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP.</param>
    /// <param name="ve">Đối tượng ngoại lệ xác thực.</param>
    public async Task HandlerValidationException(HttpContext context, ValidationException ve)
    {
        var errorMessages = ve.ErrorResponse.Errors?
            .Select(e => e.Message)
            .ToList();

        var firstMessage = errorMessages?.FirstOrDefault() ?? "Dữ liệu không hợp lệ";

        var response = new BaseResponse<object>
        {
            ErrorCode = ResponseCode.FAILED,
            Message = firstMessage,
            ErrorMessage = string.Join("; ", errorMessages ?? []),
            Data = null
        };

        context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status200OK;
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý các ngoại lệ không xác định khác và trả về thông báo lỗi thân thiện cho người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP.</param>
    /// <param name="ex">Ngoại lệ chưa xác định.</param>
    public async Task HandlerException(HttpContext context, Exception ex)
    {
        var response = new BaseResponse<object>
        {
            ErrorCode = ResponseCode.FAILED,
            Message = "Có lỗi xảy, ra vui lòng thử lại sau",
            ErrorMessage = ex.Message,
        };

        context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status200OK;
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý các ngoại lệ không xác định khác và trả về thông báo lỗi thân thiện cho người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP.</param>
    /// <param name="ex">Ngoại lệ chưa xác định.</param>
    public async Task HandlerHttpException(HttpContext context, HttpException ex)
    {
        var response = new BaseResponse<object>
        {
            ErrorCode = ResponseCode.FAILED,
            Message = ex.Message,
            ErrorMessage = ex.Message,
        };

        context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status200OK;
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }
}

using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;

/// <summary>
/// Middleware for custom Bearer token authentication.
/// </summary>
public class CustomAuthMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ITokenService _tokenService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CustomAuthMiddleware"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="next">The next middleware in the pipeline.</param>
    /// <param name="tokenService">The token service used to validate Bearer tokens.</param>
    public CustomAuthMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ITokenService tokenService)
    {
        _next = next;
        _tokenService = tokenService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the HTTP request and validates the Bearer token if present.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The HTTP context of the current request.</param>
    /// <returns>A task that represents the completion of the middleware execution.</returns>
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var authHeader = context.Request.Headers["Authorization"].FirstOrDefault();
        if (authHeader?.StartsWith("Bearer ") == true)
        {
            var token = authHeader.Substring("Bearer ".Length);
            var principal = _tokenService.ValidateToken(token);

            if (principal != null)
            {
                context.User = principal;
            }
        }

        await _next(context);
    }
}

using Hangfire;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.HoaDon;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.KhachHang;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NhanVien;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.ThanhToan;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Models;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.src.Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.BaoCaoTonThu;

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình cho Hangfire.
/// </summary>
public static class HangfireConfiguration
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Hàm mở rộng để thêm dịch vụ Hangfire vào DI container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services"></param>
    /// <param name="appSettings"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddHangfireServices(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appSettings)
    {
        services.AddHangfire(config =>
        {
            config.UseSqlServerStorage(appSettings.ConnectionStrings.JobConnection); // hoặc connection khác
            config.UseFilter(new AutomaticRetryAttribute { Attempts = 0 });
        });

        services.AddHangfireServer(options =>
        {
            options.WorkerCount = appSettings.HangfireConfig.HangfireWorker; // tùy chỉnh theo nhu cầu
        });

        // Register sync jobs
        services.AddScoped<ISyncEmployeesJob, SyncEmployeesJob>();
        
        services.AddScoped<ISyncHoaDonJob, SyncHoaDonJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncHoaDonBatchExecutor, SyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<ISyncThanhToanJob, SyncThanhToanJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncThanhToanBatchExecutor, SyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<ISyncPhanCongNhanVienJob, SyncPhanCongNhanVienJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchExecutor, SyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<ISyncKhachHangJob, SyncKhachHangJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncKhachHangBatchExecutor, SyncKhachHangBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<ISyncPhanCongToJob, SyncPhanCongToJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncPhanCongToBatchExecutor, SyncPhanCongToBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<ISyncThanhToanHuyJob, SyncThanhToanHuyJob>();
        services.AddScoped<ISyncThanhToanHuyBatchExecutor, SyncThanhToanHuyBatchExecutor>();

        services.AddScoped<IBaoCaoTonThuJob, BaoCaoTonThuJob>();

        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Đăng ký các job định kỳ.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task RegisterJobs(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {

        using var scope = serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var jobRegistry = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IJobRegistryService>();

        var jobs = await jobRegistry.GetActiveJobsAsync();

        foreach (JobDefinition job in jobs)
        {
            switch (job.Ma)
            {
                case JobNames.HoaDon:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncHoaDonJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.ThanhToan:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncThanhToanJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.NhanVien:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncEmployeesJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.PhanCongNhanVien:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncPhanCongNhanVienJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.KhachHang:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncKhachHangJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;
                

                case JobNames.PhanCongTo:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncPhanCongToJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.ThanhToanHuy:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<ISyncThanhToanHuyJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                case JobNames.BaoCaoTonThu:
                    RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<IBaoCaoTonThuJob>(
                        job.Ma,
                        x => x.Run(CancellationToken.None),
                        job.TanSuat);
                    break;

                default:
                    // Nếu cần log job chưa xử lý
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}

using Domain.Entities;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Application.Repositories;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Interface;

namespace WaterBilling.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Cài đặt mẫu Unit of Work dùng để quản lý các repository và thao tác giao dịch trên DbContext.
/// </summary>
public class UnitOfWork : IUnitOfWork
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;
    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="NhanVien"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IUserRepository UserRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="PhongBan"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IPhongBanRepository PhongBanRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="ChucVu"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IChucVuRepository ChucVuRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="PhienBan"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IPhienBanRepository PhienBanRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="KhachHang"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IKhachHangRepository KhachHangRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HoaDon"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHoaDonRepository HoaDonRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LichSuHoatDong"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILichSuHoatDongRepository LichSuHoatDongRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="NhacNoRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public INhacNoRepository NhacNoRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LyDoDongNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILyDoDongNuocRepository LyDoDongNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LoaiTroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILoaiTroNgaiRepository LoaiTroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LyDoTroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILyDoTroNgaiRepository LyDoTroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HinhThucDongNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHinhThucDongNuocRepository HinhThucDongNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="DongNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IDongNuocRepository DongNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="TroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ITroNgaiRepository TroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HinhAnhRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHinhAnhRepository HinhAnhRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="MoNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IMoNuocRepository MoNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="CauHinhUngDungRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ICauHinhUngDungRepository CauHinhUngDungRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LichSuNhacNoRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILichSuNhacNoRepository LichSuNhacNoRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="ThongBaoChuaThanhToanRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IThongBaoChuaThanhToanRepository TBChuaTTRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LoaiDongBoRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILoaiDongBoRepository LoaiDongBoRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LichSuDongBoRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILichSuDongBoRepository LichSuDongBoRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="GhiThuIDEInvoice"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IGhiThuIDEInvoiceRepository GhiThuIDEInvoiceRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="KhachHangLogRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IKhachHangLogRepository KhachHangLogRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LogHoatDongRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILogHoatDongRepository LogHoatDongRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HeSoKCNRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHeSoKCNRepository HeSoKCNRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="PQNhomChucNangRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IPQNhomChucNangRepository PQNhomChucNangRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Khởi tạo một <see cref="UnitOfWork"/> với DbContext được inject.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">Ngữ cảnh dữ liệu ứng dụng.</param>
    public UnitOfWork(ApplicationDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _context = dbContext;
        UserRepository = new UserRepository(_context);
        PhongBanRepository = new PhongBanRepository(_context);
        ChucVuRepository = new ChucVuRepository(_context);
        PhienBanRepository = new PhienBanRepository(_context);
        KhachHangRepository = new KhachHangRepository(_context);
        HoaDonRepository = new HoaDonRepository(_context);
        LichSuHoatDongRepository = new LichSuHoatDongRepository(_context);
        NhacNoRepository = new NhacNoRepository(_context);
        LyDoDongNuocRepository = new LyDoDongNuocRepository(_context);
        LoaiTroNgaiRepository = new LoaiTroNgaiRepository(_context);
        LyDoTroNgaiRepository = new LyDoTroNgaiRepository(_context);
        HinhThucDongNuocRepository = new HinhThucDongNuocRepository(_context);
        DongNuocRepository = new DongNuocRepository(_context);
        TroNgaiRepository = new TroNgaiRepository(_context);
        HinhAnhRepository = new HinhAnhRepository(_context);
        MoNuocRepository = new MoNuocRepository(_context);
        CauHinhUngDungRepository = new CauHinhUngDungRepository(_context);
        LichSuNhacNoRepository = new LichSuNhacNoRepository(_context);
        TBChuaTTRepository = new ThongBaoChuaThanhToanRepository(_context);
        LoaiDongBoRepository = new LoaiDongBoRepository(_context);
        LichSuDongBoRepository = new LichSuDongBoRepository(_context);
        GhiThuIDEInvoiceRepository = new GhiThuIDEInvoiceRepository(_context);
        KhachHangLogRepository = new KhachHangLogRepository(_context);
        LogHoatDongRepository = new LogHoatDongRepository(_context);
        HeSoKCNRepository = new HeSoKCNRepository(_context);
        PQNhomChucNangRepository = new PQNhomChucNangRepository(_context);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lưu tất cả các thay đổi trong DbContext xuống cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="token">Token hủy bất đồng bộ.</param>
    public async Task SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken token)
        => await _context.SaveChangesAsync(token);

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện hành động trong một giao dịch database (đồng bộ).
    /// Nếu có lỗi, rollback và ném ra <see cref="TransactionException"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">Hành động cần thực hiện.</param>
    /// <param name="token">Token hủy bất đồng bộ.</param>
    public async Task ExecuteTransactionAsync(Action action, CancellationToken token)
    {
        using var transaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(token);
        try
        {
            action();
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(token);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(token);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(token);
            throw TransactionException.TransactionNotExecuteException(ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện hành động bất đồng bộ trong một giao dịch database.
    /// Nếu có lỗi, rollback và ném ra <see cref="TransactionException"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">Hàm bất đồng bộ cần thực hiện trong transaction.</param>
    /// <param name="token">Token hủy bất đồng bộ.</param>
    public async Task ExecuteTransactionAsync(Func<Task> action, CancellationToken token)
    {
        using var transaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(token);
        try
        {
            await action();
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(token);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(token);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(token);
            throw TransactionException.TransactionNotExecuteException(ex);
        }
    }
}

using System.Text;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.Text.Json;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
public static class AuthenticationExtensions
{

    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    public static void AddAuth(this IServiceCollection services, Identity identitySettings)
    {
        var authenticationBuilder = services.AddAuthentication();
        authenticationBuilder.AddJwtBearer($"{JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme}", options =>
        {
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuer = true,
                ValidateLifetime = true,
                ValidateAudience = true,
                ValidIssuer = identitySettings.Issuer,
                ValidAudience = identitySettings.Audience,
                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(identitySettings.Key)),
                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
            };
            options.Authority = identitySettings.Issuer;
            options.RequireHttpsMetadata = identitySettings.ValidateHttps;
            // 👇 Custom lỗi 401
            options.Events = new JwtBearerEvents
            {
                OnChallenge = context =>
                {
                    // Ngăn ASP.NET trả về mặc định 401
                    context.HandleResponse();
                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

                    var response = new
                    {
                        error_code = ResponseCode.FAILED,
                        message = UserErrorMessage.Unauthorized,
                        data = (object)null
                    };

                    var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(response);
                    return context.Response.WriteAsync(json);
                }
            };
        });

        services.AddAuthorization();
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.SchemaFilter;
using MicroElements.Swashbuckle.FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Filters;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.SignIn;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.SignOut;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.RefreshToken;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;


/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for configuring Swagger in the application.
/// </summary>
public static class SwaggerExtension
{
    private static readonly string[] Value = ["Bearer"];

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình Swagger OpenAPI cho ứng dụng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services"></param>
    /// <param name="appSettings"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddSwaggerOpenAPI(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appSettings)
    {
        services.AddFluentValidationRulesToSwagger();

        services.AddSwaggerGen(options =>
        {
            options.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
            {
                Title = appSettings.AppConfigs.AppName,
                Version = "v1",
                Description = appSettings.AppConfigs.AppName,
                Contact = new OpenApiContact
                {
                    Email = "dev@gmail.com",
                    Name = "Dev",
                    Url = new Uri("http://localhost.com"),
                },
                License = new OpenApiLicense()
                {
                    Name = "MIT License",
                    Url = new Uri("https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT")
                }
            });
            options.DocInclusionPredicate((docName, apiDesc) =>
            {
                // Bỏ qua mọi route có "admin" trong path
                var relativePath = apiDesc.RelativePath?.ToLower() ?? "";
                return !relativePath.StartsWith("admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                       !relativePath.StartsWith("admin/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            });
            // Enable XML comments
            var xmlFile = $"{System.Reflection.Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetName().Name}.xml";
            var xmlPath = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, xmlFile);
            options.IncludeXmlComments(xmlPath, includeControllerXmlComments: true);

            // Add security definition for Bearer token
            var securityScheme = new OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Description = "JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: \"Authorization: Bearer {token}\"",
                Name = "Authorization",
                Scheme = "bearer",
                Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                Reference = new OpenApiReference
                {
                    Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme,
                    Id = "Bearer"
                }
            };
            options.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", securityScheme);

            var securityRequirement = new OpenApiSecurityRequirement { { securityScheme, Value } };
            options.AddSecurityRequirement(securityRequirement);

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Build and Run Commands

```bash
# Build
dotnet build nhabe-billing-api.sln

# Run (development)
dotnet run --project WaterBilling/WaterBilling.csproj

# Run with hot reload
dotnet watch run --project WaterBilling/WaterBilling.csproj

# Restore packages
dotnet restore nhabe-billing-api.sln

# Clean build
dotnet clean nhabe-billing-api.sln && dotnet build nhabe-billing-api.sln
```

## Architecture Overview

This is a .NET 8 Web API following **Clean Architecture** with **CQRS** pattern using MediatR.

### Layer Structure (`WaterBilling/src/`)

```
Domain/          - Entities, Enums, DTOs, Constants (no dependencies)
Application/     - Business logic, Services, Repositories, MediatR Features
Infrastructure/  - EF Core DbContext, Dapper, Hangfire jobs, SQL queries
Web/             - Controllers, Middleware, Validators, Extensions
Models/          - Request/Response DTOs organized by feature
```

### Key Patterns

- **CQRS**: Commands/Queries in `Application/Features/` with MediatR handlers
- **Repository + Unit of Work**: `GenericRepository<T>` base, `IUnitOfWork` for transactions
- **Dual Data Access**: EF Core (ORM) + Dapper (raw SQL in `Infrastructure/SqlQueries/`)

### Database

- **Primary**: SQL Server via `ApplicationDbContext`
- **Multiple connections**: DefaultConnection, JobConnection, DocSoNB, Billing, NhaBeReport
- **Entities**: 30+ tables - NhanVien (Employee), KhachHang (Customer), HoaDon (Invoice), ThanhToan (Payment), etc.

### Background Jobs (Hangfire)

Jobs in `Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/`:
- SyncHoaDonJob, SyncThanhToanJob - Invoice/Payment sync
- SyncKhachHangJob, SyncEmployeesJob - Customer/Employee sync
- BaoCaoTonThuJob - Revenue reports

### Middleware Pipeline

1. GlobalExceptionMiddleware - Catches exceptions, returns `BaseResponse<T>`
2. LoggingMiddleware - Request/response logging
3. PerformanceMiddleware - Request timing
4. CustomAuthMiddleware - JWT Bearer token validation

### API Conventions

- Route prefix: `/api` (configurable via `AppConfigs.ApiPrefix`)
- Response format: `BaseResponse<T>` with error codes
- JSON naming: snake_case lowercase
- Validation: FluentValidation in `Web/Validations/`

### Configuration

- `appsettings.json`: AppConfigs, HangfireConfig, ConnectionStrings, Identity (JWT), ExternalSystem

## Code Conventions

- Vietnamese naming for domain entities and business logic
- Controllers inherit from `BaseController`
- Services registered via extension methods in `ConfigureServices.cs` per layer

Key Architectural Patterns:


    

  • Repository Pattern: Generic + specific repositories for data access
    • 

  • Unit of Work Pattern: Transactional operations across multiple repositories
    • 

  • Dependency Injection: Full DI with transient/scoped registrations
    • 

  • CQRS Pattern: MediatR commands/handlers for data synchronization jobs
    • 

  • DTO Pattern: Separate models for requests/responses
    • 

  • Exception Handling: Custom exceptions with global middleware handler
    • 

  • Middleware Pipeline: Layered middleware for cross-cutting concerns
    • 

  • Authentication: JWT tokens + Cookie fallback + Custom middleware
    •

5. KEY PATTERNS & CONVENTIONS


Naming Conventions:


    

  • Controllers: {Feature}Controller (e.g., CustomerController)
    • 

  • Services: I{Service}Service interface + {Service}Service implementation
    • 

  • Repositories: I{Entity}Repository + {Entity}Repository
    • 

  • DTOs: Organized by feature in /Models (e.g., Models/Customer/GetCustomer/GetCustomerRequest.cs)
    • 

  • Database entities: PascalCase in Vietnamese (e.g., KhachHang, HoaDon)
    • 



Route Prefix Convention:


    

  • Global route prefix from config: {ApiPrefix}/{controller}/{action}
    • 

  • Default ApiPrefix: "api" in settings
    • 

  • Lowercase URLs enforced throughout
    • 

  • Example: GET /api/customer/get-by-id/{id}
    • 



Response Format:


public class BaseResponse<T>
{
    public T? Data { get; set; }
    public string? Message { get; set; }
    public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    public string ErrorCode { get; set; }  // "000" for success, "999" for failure
}



Error Handling:


    

  • Custom exception types for different scenarios
    • 

  • Global exception middleware converts exceptions to standardized responses
    • 

  • HTTP 200 status code for all responses (errors included)
    • 

  • Detailed error logging to daily rolling files
    • 



Authentication:


    

  • JWT tokens with configurable expiry (default 14400s)
    • 

  • Refresh token mechanism
    • 

  • Bearer scheme: [Authorize(AuthenticationSchemes = "Bearer")]
    • 

  • Cookie fallback for admin panels (Swagger, Hangfire)
    • 



Serialization:


    

  • snake_case JSON property naming (e.g., customer_id)
    • 

  • Enum serialization as strings
    • 

  • DateTime/DateTimeOffset in ISO 8601 format
    • 

  • Decimal precision to 2 places for currency
    • 

  • Reference cycle handling
    • 



Validation:


    

  • FluentValidation with auto validation enabled
    • 

  • Custom validators per request/command
    • 

  • Validation errors aggregated in response
    • 



Service Localization:


    

  • Vietnamese language support (LangKey constants)
    • 

  • LocalizationService for message translation
    •

# Editing this README

When you're ready to make this README your own, just edit this file and use the handy template below (or feel free to structure it however you want - this is just a starting point!). Thank you to [makeareadme.com](https://www.makeareadme.com/) for this template.

## Suggestions for a good README
Every project is different, so consider which of these sections apply to yours. The sections used in the template are suggestions for most open source projects. Also keep in mind that while a README can be too long and detailed, too long is better than too short. If you think your README is too long, consider utilizing another form of documentation rather than cutting out information.

## Name
Choose a self-explaining name for your project.

## Description
Let people know what your project can do specifically. Provide context and add a link to any reference visitors might be unfamiliar with. A list of Features or a Background subsection can also be added here. If there are alternatives to your project, this is a good place to list differentiating factors.

## Badges
On some READMEs, you may see small images that convey metadata, such as whether or not all the tests are passing for the project. You can use Shields to add some to your README. Many services also have instructions for adding a badge.

## Visuals
Depending on what you are making, it can be a good idea to include screenshots or even a video (you'll frequently see GIFs rather than actual videos). Tools like ttygif can help, but check out Asciinema for a more sophisticated method.

## Installation
Within a particular ecosystem, there may be a common way of installing things, such as using Yarn, NuGet, or Homebrew. However, consider the possibility that whoever is reading your README is a novice and would like more guidance. Listing specific steps helps remove ambiguity and gets people to using your project as quickly as possible. If it only runs in a specific context like a particular programming language version or operating system or has dependencies that have to be installed manually, also add a Requirements subsection.

## Usage
Use examples liberally, and show the expected output if you can. It's helpful to have inline the smallest example of usage that you can demonstrate, while providing links to more sophisticated examples if they are too long to reasonably include in the README.

## Support
Tell people where they can go to for help. It can be any combination of an issue tracker, a chat room, an email address, etc.

## Roadmap
If you have ideas for releases in the future, it is a good idea to list them in the README.

## Contributing
State if you are open to contributions and what your requirements are for accepting them.

For people who want to make changes to your project, it's helpful to have some documentation on how to get started. Perhaps there is a script that they should run or some environment variables that they need to set. Make these steps explicit. These instructions could also be useful to your future self.

You can also document commands to lint the code or run tests. These steps help to ensure high code quality and reduce the likelihood that the changes inadvertently break something. Having instructions for running tests is especially helpful if it requires external setup, such as starting a Selenium server for testing in a browser.

## Authors and acknowledgment
Show your appreciation to those who have contributed to the project.

## License
For open source projects, say how it is licensed.

## Project status
If you have run out of energy or time for your project, put a note at the top of the README saying that development has slowed down or stopped completely. Someone may choose to fork your project or volunteer to step in as a maintainer or owner, allowing your project to keep going. You can also make an explicit request for maintainers.

using Serilog;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

// Tạo thư mục Logs nếu chưa có
var logPath = Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "Logs");
Directory.CreateDirectory(logPath);

// Cấu hình Serilog để log ra file theo ngày
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .WriteTo.File(
        path: Path.Combine(logPath, "log-.txt"),
        rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
        outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{Level}] {Message}{NewLine}{Exception}"
    )
    .CreateLogger();

// <summary>
// Điểm khởi đầu của ứng dụng WaterBilling. Thiết lập cấu hình, đăng ký dịch vụ và khởi động pipeline.
// </summary>
var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
builder.Host.UseSerilog(); //Phải sau CreateBuilder

// <summary>
// Tải thông tin cấu hình ứng dụng từ appsettings.json hoặc môi trường.
// Ném ngoại lệ nếu không tìm thấy cấu hình.
// </summary>
var configuration = builder.Configuration.Get<AppSettings>()
    ?? throw ProgramException.AppsettingNotSetException();

// <summary>
// Đăng ký cấu hình đã tải vào container để dùng trong toàn bộ ứng dụng.
// </summary>
builder.Services.AddSingleton(configuration);

// <summary>
// Gọi các phương thức mở rộng để cấu hình service và pipeline (middleware, endpoint,...) cho ứng dụng.
// </summary>
var app = await builder
    .ConfigureServices(configuration)
    .ConfigurePipelineAsync(configuration);

// <summary>
// Chạy ứng dụng.
// </summary>
await app.RunAsync();

/// <summary>
/// Partial class Program để hỗ trợ integration test với WebApplicationFactory.
/// </summary>
public partial class Program { }

using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using Hangfire;
using Hangfire.Dashboard;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// Cung cấp các phương thức mở rộng để cấu hình dịch vụ và pipeline của ứng dụng.
/// </summary>
public static class HostingExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình các dịch vụ cho ứng dụng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">Đối tượng WebApplicationBuilder.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cài đặt ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>Đối tượng WebApplication đã được cấu hình.</returns>
    public static WebApplication ConfigureServices(this WebApplicationBuilder builder, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
        {
            options.AddPolicy("AllowSpecificOrigin",
                policy =>
                {
                    policy.AllowAnyOrigin()
                          .AllowAnyHeader()
                          .AllowAnyMethod();
                });
        });
        builder.Services.AddInfrastructuresService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddApplicationService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddWebAPIService(appsettings);
        builder.Services.AddHangfireServices(appsettings);

        return builder.Build();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình pipeline middleware cho ứng dụng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="app">Đối tượng WebApplication.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cài đặt ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>Đối tượng WebApplication đã được cấu hình.</returns>
    public async static Task<WebApplication> ConfigurePipelineAsync(this WebApplication app, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        using var loggerFactory = LoggerFactory.Create(builder => { });
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();

        if (appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix != null && appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix.Length > 0)
        {
            app.UsePathBase($"/{appsettings.AppConfigs.SubAppPrefix}");
        }

        app.UseMiddleware<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();
        app.UseMiddleware<LoggingMiddleware>();
        app.UseMiddleware<PerformanceMiddleware>();
        app.UseStaticFiles();

        app.UseAuthentication();
        app.UseMiddleware<CustomAuthMiddleware>();
        app.UseAuthorization();

        app.UseHttpsRedirection();
        app.UseCors("AllowSpecificOrigin");




        // Swagger UI
        app.UseWhen(ctx => (
            ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/swagger")), subApp =>
        {
            subApp.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
            {
                if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.IsAuthen)
                {
                    if (!ctx.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
                    {
                        ctx.Response.Redirect($"{ctx.Request.PathBase}/admin/login");
                        return;
                    }
                }

                await next();
            });
        });
        app.UseSwagger(appsettings);

        app.MapControllers();

        // Hangfire dashboard
        var hangfirePath = appsettings.HangfireConfig.Path;
        app.UseWhen(ctx => ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(hangfirePath), async sub =>
        {
            sub.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
            {
                if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.IsAuthen)
                {
                    if (!ctx.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
                    {
                        ctx.Response.Redirect($"{ctx.Request.PathBase}/admin/login");
                        return;
                    }
                }
                await next();
            });

            sub.UseHangfireDashboard(hangfirePath, new DashboardOptions
            {
                Authorization = new[] { new HangfireCookieAuthorizationFilter() }
            });
            if (appsettings.HangfireConfig.UseHangfire)
            {

                await HangfireConfiguration.RegisterJobs(app.Services);
            }
        });

        // Thêm route mặc định để hiển thị tên ứng dụng
        app.MapGet("/", () => appsettings.AppConfigs.AppName);

        return app;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Lớp xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cookie.
/// </summary>
public class HangfireCookieAuthorizationFilter : IDashboardAuthorizationFilter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cách kiểm tra cookie của người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Authorize(DashboardContext context)
    {
        var user = context.GetHttpContext().User;
        return user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true && user.IsInRole("Admin");
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// class này cần được định nghĩa ở đâu đó trong project
    /// </summary>
    public class BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter : IDashboardAuthorizationFilter
    {
        private readonly string _username;
        private readonly string _password;

        /// <summary>
        /// Khởi tạo một thể hiện của BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter với tên người dùng và mật khẩu.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="username"></param>
        /// <param name="password"></param>
        public BasicAuthAuthorizationFilter(string username, string password)
        {
            _username = username;
            _password = password;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Xác thực quyền truy cập vào Hangfire Dashboard bằng cách kiểm tra thông tin xác thực Basic Auth.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool Authorize(DashboardContext context)
        {
            var httpContext = context.GetHttpContext();
            var header = httpContext.Request.Headers["Authorization"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header)) return Challenge(httpContext);

            if (!header.ToString().StartsWith("Basic ")) return Challenge(httpContext);

            var encodedCredentials = header.ToString().Substring("Basic ".Length).Trim();
            var credentialBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(encodedCredentials);
            var credentials = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(credentialBytes).Split(':');

            if (credentials.Length != 2) return Challenge(httpContext);

            var username = credentials[0];
            var password = credentials[1];

            if (username == _username && password == _password)
                return true;

            return Challenge(httpContext);
        }

        private bool Challenge(HttpContext httpContext)
        {
            httpContext.Response.Headers["WWW-Authenticate"] = "Basic realm=\"Hangfire Dashboard\"";
            httpContext.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
