using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Services;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Application;

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình và đăng ký các dịch vụ trong tầng Application.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Đăng ký các service logic nghiệp vụ của ứng dụng vào DI container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">Đối tượng IServiceCollection của hệ thống.</param>
    /// <param name="appsettings">Cấu hình ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>IServiceCollection sau khi đã đăng ký dịch vụ.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appsettings)
    {
        services.AddTransient<IAuthService, AuthService>();
        services.AddTransient<IUserService, UserService>();
        services.AddTransient<ITokenService, TokenService>();
        services.AddTransient<IDeviceService, DeviceService>();
        services.AddTransient<IHomeService, HomeService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerService, CustomerService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerDebtService, CustomerDebtService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerCutoffService, CustomerCutoffService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerReopenService, CustomerReopenService>();
        services.AddTransient<ICustomerDashboardService, CustomerDashboardService>();
        services.AddTransient<IReportService, ReportService>();
        services.AddTransient<ISharedService, SharedService>();
        services.AddTransient<INhaBeService, NhaBeService>();
        services.AddTransient<IWorkService, WorkService>();
        services.AddTransient<ISyncJobService, SyncJobService>();
        services.AddTransient<IActivityLogService, ActivityLogService>();

        
        services.AddTransient<ICurrentTime, CurrentTime>();


        return services;
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.HoaDon;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.ThanhToan;

namespace WaterBilling.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Provides extension methods to configure infrastructure services for the application.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures infrastructure services such as database contexts and repositories.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection to which services will be added.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The application settings containing configuration values.</param>
    /// <returns>The updated service collection.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructuresService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings configuration)
    {
        services.AddMemoryCache();

        services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
        services.AddScoped<LocalizationService>();
        // Configure the database context based on the configuration
        if (configuration.AppConfigs.UseInMemoryDatabase)
        {
            // Use an in-memory database for development or testing
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseInMemoryDatabase("WaterBilling"));
        }
        else
        {
            // Use SQL Server with retry-on-failure for production
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseSqlServer(configuration.ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection,
                sqlOptions => sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3,
                                                              maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                                                              errorNumbersToAdd: null))
                                        .LogTo(Console.WriteLine, LogLevel.Information)
                                        .EnableSensitiveDataLogging()
             );
        }

        // 🟡 Thêm dòng sau ngay sau khi services được lấy:
        services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
        {
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>();
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>();
        });

        // Register repository and unit of work services
        services.AddScoped<IUnitOfWork, UnitOfWork>();

        // Register the Dapper context
        services.AddScoped<IDapperContext, DapperContext>();

        services.AddScoped<IJobRegistryService, JobRegistryService>();

        return services;
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace WaterBilling.Application;

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình tổng thể của ứng dụng, được map từ appsettings.json.
/// </summary>
public class AppSettings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin cấu hình chung của ứng dụng, như tên, URL, v.v.
    /// </summary>
    public AppConfigs AppConfigs { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin cấu hình chung của ứng Hangfire
    /// </summary>
    public HangfireConfig HangfireConfig { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thông tin chuỗi kết nối database.
    /// </summary>
    public ConnectionStrings ConnectionStrings { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình liên quan đến xác thực và JWT token.
    /// </summary>
    public Identity Identity { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình hệ thống bên ngoài (như NhaBe).
    /// </summary>
    public ExternalSystem ExternalSystem { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Thông tin chuỗi kết nối cơ sở dữ liệu.
/// </summary>
public class ConnectionStrings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối mặc định đến database.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string DefaultConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho Hangfire.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value></value>
    public string JobConnection { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho KinhDoanhNhabe.
    /// </summary>
    public string KinhDoanhNhabeReportConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho DocSoNB.
    /// </summary>
    public string DocSoNBConnection { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho Billing.
    /// </summary>
    public string BillingConnection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Chuỗi kết nối đến database dùng cho NhaBe.
    /// </summary>
    public string ServiceNhaBeConnection { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình xác thực và JWT.
/// </summary>
public class Identity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Có đang chạy ở môi trường local không (ảnh hưởng đến xác thực).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public bool IsLocal { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Khóa bí mật dùng để ký JWT.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Key { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Khóa bí mật dùng để ký JWT.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string KeyRefresh { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Issuer cho token JWT (người phát hành).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Issuer { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Audience cho token JWT (người nhận hợp lệ).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string Audience { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Audience cho token JWT (người nhận hợp lệ).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string AudienceRefresh { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Base domain cho scope (thường dùng khi cấu hình OpenID).
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string ScopeBaseDomain { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Có bắt buộc xác thực HTTPS không.
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public bool ValidateHttps { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thời gian hết hạn token (tính bằng ngày).
    /// </summary>
    public int ExpiredTime { get; set; } = 10;

    /// <summary>
    /// Thời gian hết hạn token (tính bằng ngày).
    /// </summary>
    public int RefreshTokenExpiredTime { get; set; } = 10;
}


/// <summary>
/// Cấu hình cho các hệ thống bên ngoài.
/// </summary>
public class ExternalSystem
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Domain nhà bè
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    public string NhaBeUrl { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tên đăng nhập
    /// </summary>
    public string Username { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mật khẩu
    /// </summary>
    public string Password { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mật khẩu
    /// </summary>
    public string LoginEndpoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mật khẩu
    /// </summary>
    public string GetUserEndpoint { get; set; }

}

/// <summary>
/// Nhưngg cấu hình chung của ứng dụng, như tên, URL, sử dụng Hangfire, v.v.

public class AppConfigs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tên của ứng dụng
    /// </summary>
    public string AppName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL của ứng dụng (dùng cho Swagger hoặc redirect).
    /// </summary>
    public string AppUrl { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL của ứng dụng (dùng cho Swagger hoặc redirect).
    /// </summary>
    public string ApiPrefix { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL của ứng dụng (dùng cho Swagger hoặc redirect).
    /// </summary>
    public string SubAppPrefix { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Cho biết có sử dụng InMemory DB không (dùng cho test).
    /// </summary>
    public bool UseInMemoryDatabase { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thời gian tối đa thực hiện truy vấn
    /// </summary>
    public int CommandTimeout { get; set; } = 30;

}

/// <summary>
/// Nhưngg cấu hình chung của Hangfire
/// </summary>
public class HangfireConfig
{

    /// <summary>

    /// <value></value>

    /// <summary>
    /// Password cho hangfire
    /// </summary>
    /// <value></value>
    public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty ;
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Authorization;
using WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;
using WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace WaterBilling.Web;

/// <summary>
/// Cung cấp các phương thức để cấu hình dịch vụ cho Web API.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thêm và cấu hình các dịch vụ cần thiết cho Web API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">Đối tượng IServiceCollection.</param>
    /// <param name="appSettings">Cài đặt ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <returns>Đối tượng IServiceCollection đã được cập nhật.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddWebAPIService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appSettings)
    {;
        services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
        services.AddAutoMapper(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
        services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
        services.AddFluentValidationAutoValidation();
        services.AddFluentValidationClientsideAdapters();
        services.SetupMvc(appSettings);

        services.AddAuth(appSettings.Identity);
        services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
        services.AddMemoryCache();
        services.AddSingleton<IAuthorizationHandler, HasScopeHandler>();

        // Middleware
        services.AddSingleton<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();
        services.AddSingleton<PerformanceMiddleware>();
        services.AddSingleton<Stopwatch>();

        // Các lớp mở rộng
        services.AddHealthChecks();
        services.AddHttpClient();
        services.AddSwaggerOpenAPI(appSettings);

        // Cấu hình Json
        services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options =>
        {
            options.SerializerOptions.WriteIndented = true;
            options.SerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower;
            options.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
        });
        services.Configure<RouteOptions>(options =>
        {
            options.LowercaseUrls = true; // Chuyển tất cả URL thành chữ thường
        });
        return services;
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Interface;

namespace WaterBilling.Application;

/// <summary>
/// Định nghĩa Unit of Work để quản lý và commit các thay đổi dữ liệu theo phiên làm việc.
/// </summary>
public interface IUnitOfWork
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    IUserRepository UserRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu phòng ban.
    /// </summary>
    IPhongBanRepository PhongBanRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu chức vụ.
    /// </summary>
    IChucVuRepository ChucVuRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu phiên bản.
    /// </summary>
    IPhienBanRepository PhienBanRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    IKhachHangRepository KhachHangRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu hóa đơn khách hàng.
    /// </summary>
    IHoaDonRepository HoaDonRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu lịch sử hoạt động của nhân viên.
    /// </summary>
    ILichSuHoatDongRepository LichSuHoatDongRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository truy xuất dữ liệu nhắc nợ.
    /// </summary>
    INhacNoRepository NhacNoRepository { get; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LyDoDongNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILyDoDongNuocRepository LyDoDongNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LoaiTroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILoaiTroNgaiRepository LoaiTroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LyDoTroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ILyDoTroNgaiRepository LyDoTroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HinhThucDongNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHinhThucDongNuocRepository HinhThucDongNuocRepository { get; }

    public IDongNuocRepository DongNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="TroNgaiRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public ITroNgaiRepository TroNgaiRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="HinhAnhRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IHinhAnhRepository HinhAnhRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="MoNuocRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public IMoNuocRepository MoNuocRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="CauHinhUngDungRepository"/>.

    public ICauHinhUngDungRepository CauHinhUngDungRepository { get; }

    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LichSuNhacNoRepository"/>.

    public ILichSuNhacNoRepository LichSuNhacNoRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="TBChuaTTRepository"/>.

    /// <value></value>
    public IThongBaoChuaThanhToanRepository TBChuaTTRepository { get; }

    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LoaiDongBoRepository"/>.

    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="LichSuDongBoRepository"/>.

    /// <summary>
    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="GhiThuIDEInvoice"/>.

    /// Repository thao tác với thực thể <see cref="PQNhomChucNangRepository"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value></value>
    public IPQNhomChucNangRepository PQNhomChucNangRepository { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lưu tất cả các thay đổi vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="token">Token để hủy thao tác bất đồng bộ nếu cần.</param>
    Task SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken token);

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện các hành động trong một transaction đồng bộ.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">Action cần thực thi trong transaction.</param>
    /// <param name="token">Token để hủy thao tác.</param>
    Task ExecuteTransactionAsync(Action action, CancellationToken token);

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện các hành động bất đồng bộ trong một transaction.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">Hàm async cần thực thi trong transaction.</param>
    /// <param name="token">Token để hủy thao tác.</param>
    Task ExecuteTransactionAsync(Func<Task> action, CancellationToken token);
}

public class ApplicationDbContext : DbContext
{
    /// <summary>

    }

    /// <summary>

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Utilities;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.SchemaFilter;
using WaterBilling.Web.Validations;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Text.Encodings.Web;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// Extension method để cấu hình MVC, JSON và Authentication.
/// </summary>
public static class MvcExtension
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thiết lập các cấu hình cho MVC, JSON serializer, FluentValidation và Authentication scheme mặc định.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">Service collection của ứng dụng.</param>
    /// <param name="appSettings">AppSettings của ứng dụng.</param>
    public static void SetupMvc(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings appSettings)
    {
        services.Configure<ApiBehaviorOptions>(options => options.SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter = true);

        services.AddAuthentication(options =>
        {
            options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            options.DefaultChallengeScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
        })
        .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
        {
            options.LoginPath = $"{StringHelper.FullPrefix(appSettings)}/admin/login";
            options.AccessDeniedPath = $"{StringHelper.FullPrefix(appSettings)}/admin/login";
        })
        .AddScheme<AuthenticationSchemeOptions, DummyAuthHandler>("Custom", null);
        services.AddControllersWithViews();
        services.AddControllers(options =>
                {
                    options.Filters.Add(typeof(ValidateModelFilter));
                    options.Conventions.Insert(0, new GlobalRoutePrefixConvention(appSettings.AppConfigs.ApiPrefix));
                })
                .AddJsonOptions(options =>
                {


                    // Avoid reference loop issues
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;

                    // Use ISO 8601 format for DateTime and DateTimeOffset
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonDateTimeOffsetConverter());

                    // Handle reference loops
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
                    
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new TrimmingConverter());
                    // Price: 12.34567 → 12.35 (2 decimal places).
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new DecimalPrecisionConverter(2));
                    // JSON trả về có định dạng chuẩn với snake_case
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower;


                });
        services.AddFluentValidationAutoValidation();
        services.AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<Program>();
        // services.AddTransient<IValidatorInterceptor, ValidatorInterceptor>();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Handler xác thực giả dùng cho scheme "Custom".
/// Không thực hiện xác thực thật vì đã có CustomAuthMiddleware xử lý trước đó.
/// </summary>
public class DummyAuthHandler : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Khởi tạo một instance của <see cref="DummyAuthHandler"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">Tùy chọn cho scheme xác thực.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">Logger.</param>
    /// <param name="encoder">Encoder.</param>
    /// <param name="clock">Đồng hồ hệ thống.</param>
    [Obsolete]
    public DummyAuthHandler(
        IOptionsMonitor<AuthenticationSchemeOptions> options,
        ILoggerFactory logger,
        UrlEncoder encoder,
        ISystemClock clock) : base(options, logger, encoder, clock)
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Không thực hiện xác thực – chỉ để ASP.NET Core không lỗi khi yêu cầu scheme xác thực.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>Luôn trả về <see cref="AuthenticateResult.NoResult"/>.</returns>
    protected override Task<AuthenticateResult> HandleAuthenticateAsync()
    {
        // Không thực hiện xác thực ở đây vì đã có CustomAuthMiddleware
        return Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.NoResult());
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.SignIn;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.SignOut;
using WaterBilling.Models.User.RefreshToken;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using WaterBilling.Models;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Filters;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// Nhóm chức năng xác thực
/// </summary>
public class AuthController(IAuthService authService,
                         LocalizationService loc) : BaseController
{
    private readonly IAuthService _authService = authService;
    private readonly LocalizationService _loc = loc;

    /// <summary>
    /// Đăng nhập ứng dụng
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("sign-in", Name = "auth.sign-in")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [SwaggerRequestExample(typeof(UserSignInRequest), typeof(UserSignInRequestExample))]
    [SwaggerResponse(200, "Successfully signed in.", typeof(BaseResponse<UserSignInResponse>))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SignIn(UserSignInRequest request)
    {
        UserSignInResponse response = await _authService.SignIn(request);
        return Ok(new BaseResponse<UserSignInResponse>(response));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Đăng xuất ứng dụng
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("sign-out", Name = "auth.sign-out")]
    [SwaggerResponse(200, "Successfully signed out.", typeof(BaseResponse<UserSignOutResponse>))]
    [SwaggerResponseExample(200, typeof(UserSignOutResponseExample))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SignOut(UserSignOutRequest request)
    {
        object? response = await _authService.SignOut(request);
        return Ok(new BaseResponse<object?>(response, _loc[LangKey.LOGOUT_SUCCES], ResponseCode.SUCCESS));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Làm mới phiên làm việc của ứng dụng
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("refresh-token")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [SwaggerResponse(200, "Successfully refresh token", typeof(BaseResponse<RefreshTokenResponse>))]
    [SwaggerResponseExample(200, typeof(RefreshTokenResponseExample))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RefreshToken(RefreshTokenRequest request)
    {
        object? response = await _authService.RefreshToken(request);
        return Ok(new BaseResponse<object?>(response, _loc[LangKey.REFRESH_TOKEN_SUCCESS], ResponseCode.SUCCESS));
    }

}

using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using WaterBilling.Models;
using ValidationException = WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions.ValidationException;

namespace WaterBilling.Web.Middlewares;

/// <summary>
/// Middleware xử lý ngoại lệ toàn cục cho ứng dụng. Bắt và chuẩn hóa lỗi trả về theo định dạng <see cref="BaseResponse{T}"/>.
/// </summary>
public class GlobalExceptionMiddleware(ILoggerFactory logger) : IMiddleware
{
    private readonly ILogger _logger = logger.CreateLogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Phương thức chính được gọi trong pipeline để xử lý request và bắt các exception.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP hiện tại.</param>
    /// <param name="next">Delegate tiếp theo trong pipeline.</param>
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, RequestDelegate next)
    {
        try
        {
            await next(context);
        }
        catch (ValidationException ve)
        {
            await HandlerValidationException(context, ve);
        }
        catch (HttpException httpEx)
        {
            await HandlerHttpException(context, httpEx);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError("GlobalExceptionMiddleware: {exception}", ex);
            await HandlerException(context, ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý các ngoại lệ xác thực đầu vào (thường từ FluentValidation).
    /// Trả về danh sách lỗi chi tiết dưới dạng <see cref="BaseResponse{T}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP.</param>
    /// <param name="ve">Đối tượng ngoại lệ xác thực.</param>
    public async Task HandlerValidationException(HttpContext context, ValidationException ve)
    {
        var errorMessages = ve.ErrorResponse.Errors?
            .Select(e => e.Message)
            .ToList();

        var firstMessage = errorMessages?.FirstOrDefault() ?? "Dữ liệu không hợp lệ";

        var response = new BaseResponse<object>
        {
            ErrorCode = ResponseCode.FAILED,
            Message = firstMessage,
            ErrorMessage = string.Join("; ", errorMessages ?? []),
            Data = null
        };

        context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status200OK;
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý các ngoại lệ không xác định khác và trả về thông báo lỗi thân thiện cho người dùng.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Ngữ cảnh HTTP.</param>
    /// <param name="ex">Ngoại lệ chưa xác định.</param>
    public async Task HandlerException(HttpContext context, Exception ex)
    {
        var response = new BaseResponse<object>
        {
            ErrorCode = ResponseCode.FAILED,
            Message = "Có lỗi xảy, ra vui lòng thử lại sau",
            ErrorMessage = ex.Message,
        };

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Build Commands

```bash
# Build the project
dotnet build

# Run the application (default: http://localhost:5000)
dotnet run

# Restore NuGet packages
dotnet restore

# Publish for production
dotnet publish -c Release
```

## Technology Stack

- **.NET 8.0** Web API with ASP.NET Core
- **Entity Framework Core 8.0** + **Dapper** for data access
- **SQL Server** with multiple database connections
- **JWT Bearer Authentication** with custom middleware
- **Hangfire** for background job processing
- **FluentValidation** for request validation
- **AutoMapper** for object mapping
- **MediatR** for CQRS pattern (sync jobs)
- **Serilog** for structured logging
- **Swagger/OpenAPI** for API documentation

## Architecture

The project follows Clean Architecture with these layers:

```
src/
├── Domain/           # Entities, DTOs, Constants, Enums
├── Application/      # Services, Interfaces, Mappings, Features (MediatR handlers)
├── Infrastructure/   # DbContext, Repositories, Dapper queries, Hangfire jobs
└── Web/              # Controllers, Middlewares, Validators, Extensions
```

**Key Patterns:**
- Repository + Unit of Work pattern for data access
- Generic repository (`GenericRepository<T>`) with specific implementations
- CQRS via MediatR for data synchronization jobs (in `Application/Features/`)
- Global exception middleware converts all exceptions to standardized responses

## Database

Multiple SQL Server connections configured in `appsettings.json`:
- `DefaultConnection` - Main WaterBilling database
- `JobConnection` - Hangfire job storage
- `DocSoNBConnection`, `BillingConnection`, `KinhDoanhNhabeReportConnection` - External integrations

Entity configuration files are in `src/Infrastructure/Data/Configurations/`.
SQL scripts (stored procedures, migrations) are in `/scripts/` folder (57+ files).

## API Conventions

- **Route prefix**: `/api/{controller}/{action}` (configurable via `AppConfigs.ApiPrefix`)
- **JSON format**: snake_case property naming
- **Response wrapper**: All responses use `BaseResponse<T>` with `ErrorCode` ("000" = success, "999" = failure)
- **Authentication**: JWT Bearer tokens, cookie fallback for admin panels

## Key Configuration

Settings in `appsettings.json`:
- `AppConfigs` - App name, URLs, prefixes
- `HangfireConfig` - Background jobs (dashboard at `/hangfire`)
- `Identity` - JWT settings (issuer, audience, expiration)
- `ExternalSystem` - NhaBe API integration URLs

## Important Files

- `Program.cs` - Application entry with Serilog setup
- `src/Web/Extensions/HostingExtensions.cs` - Middleware pipeline configuration
- `src/Infrastructure/Data/ApplicationDbContext.cs` - EF Core DbContext with 50+ DbSets
- `src/Infrastructure/UnitOfWork.cs` - Transaction coordination

Based on my exploration of your water-billing-api codebase, here's a detailed guide on how sync jobs are implemented, with code examples for creating a new NoKhoDoi (bad debt) sync job.




1. ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW


The sync job system follows a CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) pattern with MediatR and Hangfire:


Hangfire Background Job → Executor Interface (ISyncXBatchExecutor)
                         ↓
                    MediatR Command (SyncXBatchDataCommand)
                         ↓
                    Handler (IRequestHandler<SyncXBatchDataCommand>)
                         ↓
                    Dapper Query + TVP (Table-Valued Parameter) MERGE
                         ↓
                    Database MERGE Operation
                         ↓
                    Sync History Update (LichSuDongBo, LichSuDongBoChiTiet)

namespace Application.Features.NoKhoDoi.Commands

c) MediatR Command Handler


Create: /WaterBilling/src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Handlers/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler.cs


using Dapper;
using MediatR;
using System.Data;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using Application.Features.NoKhoDoi.Commands;

namespace Application.Features.NoKhoDoi.Handlers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handler for syncing NoKhoDoi (bad debt) records from Billing database
    /// to the main system using batch processing.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand, int>
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _appConn;           // Connection to target database
        private readonly IJobRegistryService _jobRegistryService;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;  // Sync history management
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;

        public SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler(
            IDapperContext appConn,
            IJobRegistryService jobRegistryService,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _appConn = appConn;
            _jobRegistryService = jobRegistryService;
            _logger = logger;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Main handler logic for syncing NoKhoDoi batch.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<int> Handle(SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var data = request.data;
            var affected = 0;

            try
            {
                // Step 1: Fetch batch from Billing database via stored procedure
                var batch = (await _appConn.Connection.QueryAsync<SyncNoKhoDoiDto>(
                    SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetNoKhoDoiSql,
                    new 
                    { 
                        LastId = data.LastId,      // Resume from where we left off
                        Skip = data.Skip,           // Pagination: skip N records
                        Take = data.Take            // Pagination: take N records
                    },
                    commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                    commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout
                )).ToList();

                // Early exit if no data to process
                if (batch.Count == 0)
                {
                    await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                        data.JobId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                        data.ChiTietId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                        0,
                        data.Total);
                    return 0;
                }

                // Step 2: Convert batch to DataTable for TVP (Table-Valued Parameter)
                var dtBatch = ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(batch);

                // Step 3: Execute MERGE stored procedure with TVP
                // MERGE: Update existing records or Insert new ones
                affected = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                    SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.MergeNoKhoDoiSql,
                    new
                    {
                        Items = dtBatch.AsTableValuedParameter("dbo.TVP_NoKhoDoi")
                    },
                    commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);

                _logger.LogInformation($"NoKhoDoi sync: Processed {affected} records");

                // Step 4: Update sync history (LichSuDongBoChiTiet and LichSuDongBo)
                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                    affected,
                    data.Total);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error syncing NoKhoDoi batch: {Message}", ex.Message);

                // Mark batch as failed in sync history
                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai,
                    0,
                    data.Total,
                    ex.Message);
            }

            // Step 5: Check if all batches are complete
            int remaining = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                SyncJobQueries.CheckJobRunning,
                new
                {
                    JobId = data.JobId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });

            // Step 6: If all batches done, finalize job and update LastIdSynced
            if (remaining == 0)
            {
                int total = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                    SyncJobQueries.SumSoLuongBatchTheoTrangThai,
                    new 
                    { 
                        JobId = data.JobId,
                        TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh
                    });

                // Check for failed batches
                var failedBatch = await _appConn.Connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<LichSuDongBoChiTiet?>(
                    SyncJobQueries.GetFailedBatFirst,
                    new 
                    { 
                        JobId = data.JobId,
                        TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai
                    });

                if (failedBatch != null)
                {
                    // Set LastIdSynced to the first failed batch's starting point
                    var sqlMinThatBai = SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.MinNoKhoDoiIdFromFailedBatch;
                    long? minThatBai = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long?>(
                        sqlMinThatBai,
                        new
                        {
                            LastId = failedBatch.LastSyncedId,
                            Skip = failedBatch.Skip,
                            Take = failedBatch.Take
                        },
                        commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                        commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);

                    if (minThatBai != null)
                    {
                        await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                            SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                            new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = minThatBai - 1 });
                    }
                    await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(data.JobId, "");
                }
                else
                {
                    // All successful - update LastIdSynced to highest ID processed
                    long lastId = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                        SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetMaxNoKhoDoiID,
                        new { LastId = data.LastId });

                    await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                        SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                        new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = lastId });
                }

                // Mark job as complete
                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(data.JobId, total);
            }

            return affected;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Updates sync history for batch and parent job.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task UpdateJobStatusAsync(
            long jobId,
            string trangThaiJob,
            long chiTietId,
            string trangThaiBatch,
            int soLuong,
            int duKien,
            string ghiChu = "")
        {
            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                SyncJobQueries.UpdateLichSuDongBo,
                new
                {
                    TrangThai = trangThaiBatch,
                    ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                    JobId = jobId,
                    SoLuong = soLuong,
                    TrangThaiJob = trangThaiJob,
                    DuKien = duKien,
                    GhiChu = ghiChu
                });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Converts NoKhoDoi DTOs to DataTable for TVP.
        /// </summary>
        private DataTable ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(List<SyncNoKhoDoiDto> batch)
        {
            var dt = new DataTable();
            dt.Columns.Add("DanhBo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("Nam", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("Ky", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoPhatHanh", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("TieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("Thue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("PhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("ThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhPhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NguoiGachNo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("NamChuyenNo", typeof(int));

            foreach (var item in batch)
            {
                dt.Rows.Add(
                    item.DanhBo, item.Nam, item.Ky, item.SoPhatHanh, item.SoHoaDon,
                    (object?)item.TieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.Thue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.PhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.ThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhPhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayThanhToan ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayGachNo ?? DBNull.Value,
                    item.NguoiGachNo,
                    (object?)item.NamChuyenNo ?? DBNull.Value
                );
            }

            return dt;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO for transporting NoKhoDoi data from source to target system.
    /// Maps directly to TVP_NoKhoDoi type used in MERGE stored procedure.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiDto
    {
        public string? DanhBo { get; set; }
        public int? Nam { get; set; }
        public int? Ky { get; set; }
        public long SoPhatHanh { get; set; }

5. STORED PROCEDURES


a) Get Procedure - Fetch NoKhoDoi from source


Create: /WaterBilling/scripts/sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql


CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi
    @LastId BIGINT,
    @Skip   INT,
    @Take   INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- Fetch NoKhoDoi records from Billing (linked server: LINK43)
    -- This example assumes NoKhoDoi data is in a table named NO_KHO_DOI
    -- in the Billing database's external link
    
    SELECT
        DANHBO AS DanhBo,
        NAM AS Nam,
        KY AS Ky,
        SO_PHAT_HANH AS SoPhatHanh,
        SO_HOA_DON AS SoHoaDon,
        TIEU_THU AS TieuThu,
        TIEN_NUOC AS TienNuoc,
        THUE AS Thue,
        PHI_BVMT AS PhiBVMT,
        THUE_DVTN AS ThueDVTN,
        TONG_CONG AS TongCong,
        DIEU_CHINH_TIEU_THU AS DieuChinhTieuThu,
        DIEU_CHINH_TIEN_NUOC AS DieuChinhTienNuoc,
        DIEU_CHINH_THUE AS DieuChinhThue,
        DIEU_CHINH_PHI_BVMT AS DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
        DIEU_CHINH_THUE_DVTN AS DieuChinhThueDVTN,
        DIEU_CHINH_TONG_CONG AS DieuChinhTongCong,
        NGAY_THANH_TOAN AS NgayThanhToan,
        NGAY_GACH_NO AS NgayGachNo,
        NGUOI_GACH_NO AS NguoiGachNo,
        NAM_CHUYEN_NO AS NamChuyenNo
    FROM [LINK43].[EIV_PAY_NHABE].[dbo].[NO_KHO_DOI]
    WHERE SO_PHAT_HANH > @LastId
    ORDER BY SO_PHAT_HANH
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;
END



b) Merge Procedure - Upsert to target


Create: /WaterBilling/scripts/sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge.sql


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge]
    @Items dbo.TVP_NoKhoDoi READONLY
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Changed TABLE (Action NVARCHAR(10));
    
    -- MERGE: Update if exists (by SoPhatHanh), Insert if new
    MERGE dbo.NoKhoDoi AS target
    USING @Items AS source
        ON target.SoPhatHanh = source.SoPhatHanh
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
            target.DanhBo = source.DanhBo,
            target.Nam = source.Nam,
            target.Ky = source.Ky,
            target.SoHoaDon = source.SoHoaDon,
            target.TieuThu = source.TieuThu,
            target.TienNuoc = source.TienNuoc,
            target.Thue = source.Thue,
            target.PhiBVMT = source.PhiBVMT,
            target.ThueDVTN = source.ThueDVTN,
            target.TongCong = source.TongCong,
            target.DieuChinhTieuThu = source.DieuChinhTieuThu,
            target.DieuChinhTienNuoc = source.DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            target.DieuChinhThue = source.DieuChinhThue,
            target.DieuChinhPhiBVMT = source.DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
            target.DieuChinhThueDVTN = source.DieuChinhThueDVTN,
            target.DieuChinhTongCong = source.DieuChinhTongCong,
            target.NgayThanhToan = source.NgayThanhToan,
            target.NgayGachNo = source.NgayGachNo,
            target.NguoiGachNo = source.NguoiGachNo,
            target.NamChuyenNo = source.NamChuyenNo
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (
            DanhBo, Nam, Ky, SoPhatHanh, SoHoaDon,
            TieuThu, TienNuoc, Thue, PhiBVMT, ThueDVTN,
            TongCong, DieuChinhTieuThu, DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            DieuChinhThue, DieuChinhPhiBVMT, DieuChinhThueDVTN,
            DieuChinhTongCong, NgayThanhToan, NgayGachNo,
            NguoiGachNo, NamChuyenNo
        )
        VALUES (
            source.DanhBo, source.Nam, source.Ky,
            source.SoPhatHanh, source.SoHoaDon,
            source.TieuThu, source.TienNuoc, source.Thue,
            source.PhiBVMT, source.ThueDVTN, source.TongCong,
            source.DieuChinhTieuThu, source.DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            source.DieuChinhThue, source.DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
            source.DieuChinhThueDVTN, source.DieuChinhTongCong,
            source.NgayThanhToan, source.NgayGachNo,
            source.NguoiGachNo, source.NamChuyenNo
        )
    OUTPUT $action INTO @Changed;
    
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Changed;
END



c) Count Procedure - Get total records to sync


Create: /WaterBilling/scripts/sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi.sql


CREATE PROCEDURE sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi
    @LastId BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [LINK43].[EIV_PAY_NHABE].[dbo].[NO_KHO_DOI]
    WHERE SO_PHAT_HANH > @LastId;
END



d) Error Recovery Procedure - Find first failed batch ID


Create: /WaterBilling/scripts/sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiThatBaiId.sql


CREATE PROCEDURE sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiThatBaiId
    @LastId BIGINT,
    @Skip INT,
    @Take INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    WITH SourceCTE AS (
        SELECT SO_PHAT_HANH
        FROM [LINK43].[EIV_PAY_NHABE].[dbo].[NO_KHO_DOI]
        WHERE SO_PHAT_HANH > @LastId
        ORDER BY SO_PHAT_HANH
        OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY
    )
    SELECT MIN(SO_PHAT_HANH) FROM SourceCTE;
END

        _connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection") ?? "";
    }

    public IDbConnection Connection => new SqlConnection(_connectionString);

Create: /WaterBilling/src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs


using MediatR;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Application.Features.NoKhoDoi.Commands;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes NoKhoDoi sync batch via CQRS/MediatR.
    /// Called by Hangfire background job.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor : ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor
    {
        private readonly ISender _sender;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor> _logger;

        public SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor(ISender sender, ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor> logger)
        {
            _sender = sender;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task ExecuteSkipTake(SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams data)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Starting NoKhoDoi batch sync: {data}", data);
            
            // Send CQRS command through MediatR
            var result = await _sender.Send(new SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand(data));
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Completed NoKhoDoi batch sync: Processed {result} records", result);
        }
    }
}

10. MERGE/UPSERT PATTERN SUMMARY


The system uses SQL MERGE statement with three clauses:


MERGE dbo.TargetTable AS target
USING @TVP AS source
    ON target.PrimaryKey = source.PrimaryKey
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET column1 = source.column1, ...    -- Update existing
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (...) VALUES (...)                   -- Insert new
OUTPUT $action INTO @Changed;



Key Benefits:


    

  • Atomic operation: All data updated in one transaction
    • 

  • Efficient: Single round-trip to database
    • 

  • Trackable: Can count INSERT vs UPDATE via OUTPUT clause
    • 

  • Resumable: Tracks LastIdSynced for checkpoint recovery
    • 





11. STATUS FLOW


Job Creation (Moi)
    ↓
Job Registered (LichSuDongBo created)
    ↓
Batch Creation (LichSuDongBoChiTiet entries)
    ↓
Batch Execution (DangXuLy) → [Fetch → Transform → MERGE]
    ↓
    ├─ Success → HoanThanh (batch)
    │   ↓ (LastIdSynced updated)
    │
    └─ Error → ThatBai (batch)
        ↓ (Can retry from this point)
        ↓
Batch Completion Check
    ├─ If more batches → Process next
    └─ If all done → Update Job Status (HoanThanh or ThatBai)





12. ERROR HANDLING & RETRY


The SyncJobService supports retry by:


    

  1. Identifying failed batch via GetFailedBatFirst
    2. 

  2. Finding its minimum ID via stored procedure
    3. 

  3. Resetting LastIdSynced to just before the failed batch
    4. 

  4. Re-queuing the failed batch through Hangfire
    5. 



// From SyncJobService.RetryJobAsync
var details = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetDetailNotComplete(id);
await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.UpdateDetailsStatusAsync(
    id, ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy);

foreach (var detail in details)
{
    switch (loaiJob.Ma)
    {
        case JobNames.NoKhoDoi:
            retrySyncJobNoKhoDoi(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
            break;
        // ...
    }
}

using System.Data;
using Application.Features.ThanhToan.Commands;
using Application.HoaDon.Commands;
using AutoMapper;
using Hangfire;
using Humanizer;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using WaterBilling.Domain.DTO;
using WaterBilling.Models;
using WaterBilling.Models.Device.CheckVersion;

namespace WaterBilling.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Service xử lý các chức năng liên quan đến thiết bị.
/// </summary>
public class SyncJobService(IUnitOfWork unitOfWork,
                        ITokenService tokenService,
                        IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
                        IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient,
                        IMapper mapper) : ISyncJobService
{
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper = mapper;
    private readonly ITokenService _tokenService = tokenService;
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật hoàn thành job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="job"></param>
    /// <param name="duKien"></param>
    /// <param name="thucTe"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo?> CompleteJobAsync(LichSuDongBo job, int duKien, int thucTe)
    {
        job.DuKien = duKien;
        job.ThucTe = thucTe;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật hoàn thành job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobId"></param>
    /// <param name="addItemCount"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo?> CompleteJobAsync(long jobId, int addItemCount)
    {
        var userId = _tokenService.GetUserId(_httpContextAccessor.HttpContext);
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(jobId);
        if (job == null) return null;
        job.ThucTe = (job.ThucTe ?? 0) + addItemCount;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;
        job.NguoiCapNhat = userId;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh;
        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật thất bại job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="job"></param>
    /// <param name="message"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> FailJobAsync(LichSuDongBo job, string message)
    {
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Bạn có thể thêm ghi chú hoặc log chi tiết vào bảng khác nếu muốn
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật thất bại job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobId"></param>
    /// <param name="message"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> FailJobAsync(long jobId, string message)
    {
        var userId = _tokenService.GetUserId(_httpContextAccessor.HttpContext);
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(jobId);
        if (job == null) return null;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Bạn có thể thêm ghi chú hoặc log chi tiết vào bảng khác nếu muốn
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lấy LastId sync của một loại đồng bộ hóa từ cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="loaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LoaiDongBo?> GetLastIdAsync(string loaiDongBo)
    {
        var loai = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(loaiDongBo);
        return loai ?? null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Danh sách job đồng bộ
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="from"></param>
    /// <param name="to"></param>
    /// <param name="status"></param>
    /// <param name="page"></param>
    /// <param name="pageSize"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<Pagination<JobHistoryDTO>> GetSyncHistoryAsync(DateTime? from, DateTime? to, string? status, int page, int pageSize)
    {
        return _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetSyncHistories(from, to, status, page, pageSize);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kiêm tra có job nào đang chạy hay không
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="loaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<bool> IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(string loaiDongBo)
    {
        var loai = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(loaiDongBo);
        return await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(loai!.ID);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<int> RetryJobAsync(long id)
    {
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (job == null)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không tìm thấy job với ID {id}");
        }
        var loaiJob = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(job.LoaiDongBoID);
        if (loaiJob == null)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không tìm thấy loaij job với ID {job.LoaiDongBoID}");
        }
        var details = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetDetailNotComplete(id);

        if (details == null || details.Count() == 0)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không có batch nào cần xử lý cho job với ID {id}");
        }

        await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.UpdateDetailsStatusAsync(id, ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy);

        foreach (var detail in details)
        {
            switch (loaiJob.Ma)
            {
                case JobNames.HoaDon:
                    retrySyncJobHoaDon(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;
                case JobNames.ThanhToan:
                    retrySyncJobThanhToan(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.PhanCongNhanVien:
                    retrySyncJobPhanCongNhanVien(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.KhachHang:
                    retrySyncJobKhachHang(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.PhanCongTo:
                    retrySyncJobPhanCongTo(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;
            }

        }
        return 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobPhanCongTo(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncPhanCongToBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncPhanCongToBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobKhachHang(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncKhachHangBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncKhachHangBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobPhanCongNhanVien(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchParams
        {
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobThanhToan(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncThanhToanBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobHoaDon(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncHoaDonBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thêm mới một công việc đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="maLoaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> StartJobAsync(string maLoaiDongBo)
    {
        var loaiDongBo = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(maLoaiDongBo);
        var log = new LichSuDongBo
        {
            LoaiDongBoID = loaiDongBo!.ID,
            Ky = DateTime.Now.Month.ToString(),
            TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.Moi,
            NgayTao = DateTime.Now,
            NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now,
        };
        await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.AddAsync(log);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return log;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mang dữ liệu từ danh sách thanh toán sang DataTable để thực hiện bulk insert
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="batch"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DataTable ToThanhToanDataTable(List<SyncThanhToanDto> batch)
    {
        var dt = new DataTable();
        dt.Columns.Add("HoaDonID", typeof(long));
        dt.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayHoaDon", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToanId", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("TenHinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("DoiTacID", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("TenDoiTac", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("UserWebID", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("HuyHD", typeof(bool));
        dt.Columns.Add("TrangThai", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayTao", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayCapNhat", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NguoiTao", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("NguoiCapNhat", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("TrangThaiTreo", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("TienThanhToan", typeof(decimal));
        dt.Columns.Add("TienDu", typeof(decimal));
        dt.Columns.Add("TienThieu", typeof(decimal));
        dt.Columns.Add("ThanhToanID", typeof(decimal));
        dt.Columns.Add("UserGachNo", typeof(int));

        foreach (var item in batch)
        {
            dt.Rows.Add(
                item.HoaDonID, item.SoHoaDon, item.NgayHoaDon, item.NgayThanhToan, item.NgayGachNo,
                item.HinhThucThanhToan, item.HinhThucThanhToanId, item.TenHinhThucThanhToan, item.DoiTacID, item.TenDoiTac,
                item.UserWebID, item.HuyHD, item.TrangThai, item.NgayTao, item.NgayCapNhat, item.NguoiTao, item.NguoiCapNhat,
                item.TrangThaiTreo, item.TienThanhToan, item.TienDu, item.TienThieu, item.ThanhToanID, item.UserGachNo
            );
        }
        return dt;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mang dữ liệu từ danh sách thanh toán hủy sang DataTable để thực hiện bulk insert
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="batch"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DataTable ToThanhToanHuyDataTable(List<SyncThanhToanHuyDTO> batch)
    {
        var tvp = new DataTable();
        tvp.Columns.Add("HuyThanhToanID", typeof(long));
        tvp.Columns.Add("HoaDonID", typeof(long));
        tvp.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayHoaDon", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToanId", typeof(int));
        tvp.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TenHinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("DoiTacID", typeof(int));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TenDoiTac", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("UserWebID", typeof(long));
        tvp.Columns.Add("HuyHD", typeof(int));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TrangThai", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayTao", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayCapNhat", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NguoiTao", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NguoiCapNhat", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TrangThaiTreo", typeof(string));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TienThanhToan", typeof(decimal));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TienDu", typeof(decimal));
        tvp.Columns.Add("TienThieu", typeof(decimal));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NgayHuy", typeof(DateTime));
        tvp.Columns.Add("NguoiHuy", typeof(string));

        foreach (var x in batch)
        {
            tvp.Rows.Add(
                x.HuyThanhToanID,
                x.HoaDonID,
                x.SoHoaDon,
                (object?)x.NgayHoaDon ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.NgayThanhToan ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.NgayGachNo ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.HinhThucThanhToanId ?? DBNull.Value,
                x.HinhThucThanhToan,
                x.TenHinhThucThanhToan,
                (object?)x.DoiTacID ?? DBNull.Value,
                x.TenDoiTac,
                (object?)x.UserWebID ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.HuyHD ?? DBNull.Value,
                x.TrangThai,
                (object?)x.NgayTao ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.NgayCapNhat ?? DBNull.Value,
                x.NguoiTao,
                x.NguoiCapNhat,
                x.TrangThaiTreo,
                (object?)x.TienThanhToan ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.TienDu ?? DBNull.Value,
                (object?)x.TienThieu ?? DBNull.Value,
                x.NgayTao,
                x.NguoiTao
            );
        }
        return tvp;
    }

using Dapper;
using MediatR;
using System.Data;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;

namespace Application.HoaDon.Commands
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý lệnh đồng bộ một batch hóa đơn từ hệ thống Billing vào hệ thống mới.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommand, int>
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _appConn;
        private readonly IJobRegistryService _jobRegistryService;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;


        /// <summary>
        /// Khởi tạo handler xử lý đồng bộ hóa đơn theo từng batch.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="appConn">Context kết nối Dapper đến hệ thống đích</param>
        /// <param name="jobRegistryService">Dịch vụ quản lý registry job</param>
        /// <param name="syncJobService">Dịch vụ quản lý trạng thái đồng bộ</param>
        /// <param name="logger">Logger ghi log</param>
        /// <param name="appSettings">Logger ghi log</param>
        public SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommandHandler(
            IDapperContext appConn,
            IJobRegistryService jobRegistryService,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            ILogger<SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _appConn = appConn;
            _jobRegistryService = jobRegistryService;
            _logger = logger;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Xử lý logic đồng bộ hóa đơn từ hệ thống Billing thông qua lệnh MERGE trực tiếp.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request">Thông tin batch cần xử lý</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Token hủy xử lý</param>
        /// <returns>Số lượng bản ghi đã xử lý</returns>
        public async Task<int> Handle(SyncHoaDonBatchDataCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var data = request.data;
            var affected = 0;
            try
            {
                //1. Lấy danh sách hóa đơn
                var batch = (await _appConn.Connection.QueryAsync<SyncHoaDonDTO>(
                    SyncHoaDonQueries.GetHoaDonSql,
                    new { LastId = data.LastId, Skip = data.Skip, Take = data.Take },
                     commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                    commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout
                )).ToList();

                //2. Merge vào bảng hóa đơn
                var dtBatch = _syncJobService.ToHoaDonDataTable(batch);
                affected = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                    SyncHoaDonQueries.MergeHoaDonSql,
                    new
                    {
                        Items = dtBatch.AsTableValuedParameter("dbo.TVP_HoaDon")
                    }, commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);

                await ReSyncHoaDonGoc(batch);

                // Cập nhật thông tin của batch
                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                    affected,
                    data.Total);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Lỗi xử lý batch đồng bộ hóa đơn: {Message}", ex.Message);

                // Cập nhật thông tin của batch
                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai,
                    0,
                    data.Total,
                    ex.Message);
            }

            int remaining = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(SyncJobQueries.CheckJobRunning,
                new
                {
                    JobId = data.JobId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });

            // Nếu tất cả batch đã hoàn thành, đánh dấu job là hoàn thành
            if (remaining == 0)
            {
                int total = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(SyncJobQueries.SumSoLuongBatchTheoTrangThai,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh });

                var failedBatch = await _appConn.Connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<LichSuDongBoChiTiet?>(SyncJobQueries.GetFailedBatFirst,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai });
                if (failedBatch != null)
                {

                    var sqlMinThatBai = SyncHoaDonQueries.MinHoaDonIdFromFailedBatch;
                    long? minThatBai = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long?>(sqlMinThatBai,
                        new
                        {
                            LastId = failedBatch.LastSyncedId,
                            Skip = failedBatch.Skip,
                            Take = failedBatch.Take,
                        });

                    if (minThatBai != null)
                    {
                        await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                            new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = minThatBai - 1 });
                    }
                    await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(data.JobId, "");
                }
                else
                {

                    long lastId = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(SyncHoaDonQueries.GetMaxThongBaoCuocID,
                        new { LastId = data.LastId });

                    await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                        new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = lastId });
                }

                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(data.JobId, total);
            }

            return affected;
        }

        private async Task<int> ReSyncHoaDonGoc(List<SyncHoaDonDTO> batch)
        {
            var idsTvp = new DataTable();
            idsTvp.Columns.Add("HoaDonID", typeof(long));
            var ids = batch.Where(x => x.DHOADONID_GOC != null).Select(x => x.DHOADONID_GOC).Distinct();
            if(!ids.Any()) return 0;

            foreach (var id in ids) idsTvp.Rows.Add(id);

            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                SyncHoaDonQueries.MergeHoaDonMoiIdSql,
                new
                {
                    HoaDonIds = idsTvp.AsTableValuedParameter("dbo.TVP_BigIntList")
                },
                commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout
            );

            return 1;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cập nhật trạng thái cho chi tiết đồng bộ và tổng quan job đồng bộ
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="jobId">ID của job</param>
        /// <param name="trangThaiJob">ID của job</param>
        /// <param name="chiTietId">ID chi tiết batch</param>
        /// <param name="trangThaiBatch">ID chi tiết batch</param>
        /// <param name="soLuong">Số lượng hóa đơn xử lý</param>
        /// <param name="duKien">Tổng số lượng dự kiến</param>
        /// <param name="ghiChu">Tổng số lượng dự kiến</param>
        private async Task UpdateJobStatusAsync(long jobId, string trangThaiJob, long chiTietId, string trangThaiBatch, int soLuong, int duKien, string ghiChu = "")
        {
            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(SyncJobQueries.UpdateLichSuDongBo,
                new
                {
                    TrangThai = trangThaiBatch,
                    ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                    JobId = jobId,
                    SoLuong = soLuong,
                    TrangThaiJob = trangThaiJob,
                    DuKien = duKien,
                    GhiChu = ghiChu
                });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cập nhật lại giá trị LastIdSynced nếu đây là batch cuối cùng của job
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="data">Thông tin batch đang xử lý</param>
        private async Task UpdateLastIdSyncedIfLastBatchAsync(SyncHoaDonBatchParams data)
        {
            if (data.Index != data.TotalBatch - 1) return;

            long lastId = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(SyncHoaDonQueries.GetMaxThongBaoCuocID,
                new { LastId = data.LastId });

            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                new
                {
                    Ma = data.MaJob,
                    LastId = lastId
                });
        }
    }
