using System.Data;
using Application.Features.ThanhToan.Commands;
using Application.HoaDon.Commands;
using AutoMapper;
using Hangfire;
using Humanizer;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application.Exceptions;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using WaterBilling.Domain.DTO;
using WaterBilling.Models;
using WaterBilling.Models.Device.CheckVersion;

namespace WaterBilling.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Service xử lý các chức năng liên quan đến thiết bị.
/// </summary>
public class SyncJobService(IUnitOfWork unitOfWork,
                        ITokenService tokenService,
                        IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
                        IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient,
                        IMapper mapper) : ISyncJobService
{
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper = mapper;
    private readonly ITokenService _tokenService = tokenService;
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật hoàn thành job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="job"></param>
    /// <param name="duKien"></param>
    /// <param name="thucTe"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo?> CompleteJobAsync(LichSuDongBo job, int duKien, int thucTe)
    {
        job.DuKien = duKien;
        job.ThucTe = thucTe;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật hoàn thành job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobId"></param>
    /// <param name="addItemCount"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo?> CompleteJobAsync(long jobId, int addItemCount)
    {
        var userId = _tokenService.GetUserId(_httpContextAccessor.HttpContext);
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(jobId);
        if (job == null) return null;
        job.ThucTe = (job.ThucTe ?? 0) + addItemCount;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;
        job.NguoiCapNhat = userId;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh;
        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật thất bại job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="job"></param>
    /// <param name="message"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> FailJobAsync(LichSuDongBo job, string message)
    {
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Bạn có thể thêm ghi chú hoặc log chi tiết vào bảng khác nếu muốn
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cập nhật thất bại job đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobId"></param>
    /// <param name="message"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> FailJobAsync(long jobId, string message)
    {
        var userId = _tokenService.GetUserId(_httpContextAccessor.HttpContext);
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(jobId);
        if (job == null) return null;
        job.TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai;
        job.NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now;

        _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.Update(job);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Bạn có thể thêm ghi chú hoặc log chi tiết vào bảng khác nếu muốn
        return job;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lấy LastId sync của một loại đồng bộ hóa từ cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="loaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LoaiDongBo?> GetLastIdAsync(string loaiDongBo)
    {
        var loai = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(loaiDongBo);
        return loai ?? null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Danh sách job đồng bộ
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="from"></param>
    /// <param name="to"></param>
    /// <param name="status"></param>
    /// <param name="page"></param>
    /// <param name="pageSize"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<Pagination<JobHistoryDTO>> GetSyncHistoryAsync(DateTime? from, DateTime? to, string? status, int page, int pageSize)
    {
        return _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetSyncHistories(from, to, status, page, pageSize);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kiêm tra có job nào đang chạy hay không
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="loaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<bool> IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(string loaiDongBo)
    {
        var loai = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(loaiDongBo);
        return await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(loai!.ID);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<int> RetryJobAsync(long id)
    {
        var job = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (job == null)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không tìm thấy job với ID {id}");
        }
        var loaiJob = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByIdAsync(job.LoaiDongBoID);
        if (loaiJob == null)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không tìm thấy loaij job với ID {job.LoaiDongBoID}");
        }
        var details = await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.GetDetailNotComplete(id);

        if (details == null || details.Count() == 0)
        {
            throw new HttpException($"Không có batch nào cần xử lý cho job với ID {id}");
        }

        await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.UpdateDetailsStatusAsync(id, ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy);

        foreach (var detail in details)
        {
            switch (loaiJob.Ma)
            {
                case JobNames.HoaDon:
                    retrySyncJobHoaDon(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;
                case JobNames.ThanhToan:
                    retrySyncJobThanhToan(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.PhanCongNhanVien:
                    retrySyncJobPhanCongNhanVien(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.KhachHang:
                    retrySyncJobKhachHang(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;

                case JobNames.PhanCongTo:
                    retrySyncJobPhanCongTo(loaiJob.Ma, detail);
                    break;
            }

        }
        return 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobPhanCongTo(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncPhanCongToBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncPhanCongToBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobKhachHang(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncKhachHangBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncKhachHangBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobPhanCongNhanVien(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchParams
        {
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncPhanCongNhanVienBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobThanhToan(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncThanhToanBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thực hiện retry một job đồng bộ hóa hóa đơn đã thất bại.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="detail"></param>
    public void retrySyncJobHoaDon(string maJob, LichSuDongBoChiTiet detail)
    {
        var payload = new SyncHoaDonBatchParams
        {
            LastId = long.Parse(detail.LastSyncedId ?? "0"),
            Skip = (int)detail.Skip,
            Take = (int)detail.Take,
            MaJob = maJob,
            JobId = detail.LichSuDongBoID,
            ChiTietId = detail.ID,
            Index = 0
        };
        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thêm mới một công việc đồng bộ hóa vào cơ sở dữ liệu.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="maLoaiDongBo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<LichSuDongBo> StartJobAsync(string maLoaiDongBo)
    {
        var loaiDongBo = await _unitOfWork.LoaiDongBoRepository.GetByMaAsync(maLoaiDongBo);
        var log = new LichSuDongBo
        {
            LoaiDongBoID = loaiDongBo!.ID,
            Ky = DateTime.Now.Month.ToString(),
            TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.Moi,
            NgayTao = DateTime.Now,
            NgayCapNhat = DateTime.Now,
        };
        await _unitOfWork.LichSuDongBoRepository.AddAsync(log);
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        return log;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mang dữ liệu từ danh sách thanh toán sang DataTable để thực hiện bulk insert
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="batch"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DataTable ToThanhToanDataTable(List<SyncThanhToanDto> batch)
    {
        var dt = new DataTable();
        dt.Columns.Add("HoaDonID", typeof(long));
        dt.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayHoaDon", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
        dt.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("HinhThucThanhToanId", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("TenHinhThucThanhToan", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("DoiTacID", typeof(int));
        dt.Columns.Add("TenDoiTac", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("UserWebID", typeof(string));
        dt.Columns.Add("HuyHD", typeof(bool));
        dt.Columns.Add("TrangThai", typeof(string));

using Dapper;
using MediatR;
using System.Data;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using Application.NoKhoDoi.Commands;

namespace Application.NoKhoDoi.Handlers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Xử lý lệnh đồng bộ một batch nợ khó đòi từ hệ thống Billing vào hệ thống mới.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand, int>
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _appConn;
        private readonly IJobRegistryService _jobRegistryService;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;

        /// <summary>
        /// Khởi tạo handler xử lý đồng bộ nợ khó đòi theo từng batch.
        /// </summary>
        public SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler(
            IDapperContext appConn,
            IJobRegistryService jobRegistryService,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _appConn = appConn;
            _jobRegistryService = jobRegistryService;
            _logger = logger;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Xử lý logic đồng bộ nợ khó đòi từ hệ thống Billing thông qua lệnh MERGE.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<int> Handle(SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var data = request.data;
            var affected = 0;
            try
            {
                // 1. Lấy danh sách nợ khó đòi từ nguồn
                var batch = (await _appConn.Connection.QueryAsync<SyncNoKhoDoiDTO>(
                    SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetNoKhoDoiSql,
                    new { LastId = data.LastId, Skip = data.Skip, Take = data.Take },
                    commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                    commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout
                )).ToList();

                if (batch.Count == 0)
                {
                    await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                        data.JobId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                        data.ChiTietId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                        0,
                        data.Total);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 2. Merge vào bảng nợ khó đòi
                    var dtBatch = ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(batch);
                    affected = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                        SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.MergeNoKhoDoiSql,
                        new
                        {
                            Items = dtBatch.AsTableValuedParameter("dbo.TVP_NoKhoDoi")
                        },
                        commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);

                    // 3. Cập nhật thông tin của batch
                    await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                        data.JobId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                        data.ChiTietId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                        affected,
                        data.Total);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Lỗi xử lý batch đồng bộ nợ khó đòi: {Message}", ex.Message);

                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai,
                    0,
                    data.Total,
                    ex.Message);
            }

            // 4. Kiểm tra batch còn lại
            int remaining = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                SyncJobQueries.CheckJobRunning,
                new
                {
                    JobId = data.JobId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });

            // 5. Nếu tất cả batch đã hoàn thành
            if (remaining == 0)
            {
                int total = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                    SyncJobQueries.SumSoLuongBatchTheoTrangThai,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh });

                var failedBatch = await _appConn.Connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<LichSuDongBoChiTiet?>(
                    SyncJobQueries.GetFailedBatFirst,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai });

                if (failedBatch != null)
                {
                    var sqlMinThatBai = SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.MinNoKhoDoiIdFromFailedBatch;
                    long? minThatBai = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long?>(
                        sqlMinThatBai,
                        new
                        {
                            LastId = failedBatch.LastSyncedId,
                            Skip = failedBatch.Skip,
                            Take = failedBatch.Take,
                        });

                    if (minThatBai != null)
                    {
                        await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                            SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                            new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = minThatBai - 1 });
                    }
                    await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(data.JobId, "");
                }
                else
                {
                    long lastId = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                        SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetMaxNoKhoDoiID,
                        new { LastId = data.LastId });

                    await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                        SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                        new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = lastId });
                }

                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(data.JobId, total);
            }

            return affected;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cập nhật trạng thái cho chi tiết đồng bộ và tổng quan job đồng bộ.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task UpdateJobStatusAsync(
            long jobId,
            string trangThaiJob,
            long chiTietId,
            string trangThaiBatch,
            int soLuong,
            int duKien,
            string ghiChu = "")
        {
            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                SyncJobQueries.UpdateLichSuDongBo,
                new
                {
                    TrangThai = trangThaiBatch,
                    ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                    JobId = jobId,
                    SoLuong = soLuong,
                    TrangThaiJob = trangThaiJob,
                    DuKien = duKien,
                    GhiChu = ghiChu
                });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Chuyển đổi danh sách nợ khó đòi sang DataTable cho TVP.
        /// </summary>
        private DataTable ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(List<SyncNoKhoDoiDTO> batch)
        {
            var dt = new DataTable();
            dt.Columns.Add("DanhBo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("Nam", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("Ky", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoPhatHanh", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("TieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("Thue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("PhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("ThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhPhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NguoiGachNo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("NamChuyenNo", typeof(int));

            foreach (var item in batch)
            {
                dt.Rows.Add(
                    item.DanhBo,
                    (object?)item.Nam ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.Ky ?? DBNull.Value,
                    item.SoPhatHanh,
                    item.SoHoaDon,
                    (object?)item.TieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.Thue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.PhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.ThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhPhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayThanhToan ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayGachNo ?? DBNull.Value,
                    item.NguoiGachNo,
                    (object?)item.NamChuyenNo ?? DBNull.Value
                );
            }

            return dt;
        }
    }

using MediatR;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Application.NoKhoDoi.Commands;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thực thi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi theo từng batch, sử dụng CQRS và MediatR.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor : ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor
    {
        private readonly ISender _sender;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor> _logger;

        /// <summary>
        /// Khởi tạo một executor xử lý batch đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="sender">CQRS sender (MediatR)</param>
        /// <param name="logger">Bộ ghi log</param>
        public SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor(ISender sender, ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor> logger)
        {
            _sender = sender;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Thực thi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="data">Thông tin batch cần xử lý</param>
        public async Task ExecuteSkipTake(SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams data)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("NoKhoDoi batch info {data}", data);
            var result = await _sender.Send(new SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommand(data));
            _logger.LogInformation("Đã xử lý batch nợ khó đòi {data} => {result} bản ghi", data, result);
        }
    }
}

using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Dapper;
using Hangfire;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using System.Data;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Job đồng bộ nợ khó đòi từ hệ thống Billing.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiJob : ISyncNoKhoDoiJob
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _dapperContext;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiJob> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;
        private const int BatchSize = 5000;

        /// <summary>
        /// Hàm khởi tạo job đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        public SyncNoKhoDoiJob(
            IDapperContext dapperContext,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiJob> logger,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient)
        {
            _dapperContext = dapperContext;
            _logger = logger;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
            _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Thực thi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Token hủy bỏ</param>
        public async Task Run(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Kiểm tra nếu còn batch chưa hoàn tất
            var isPending = await _syncJobService.IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            if (isPending)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Đang có batch nợ khó đòi chưa hoàn tất. Dừng đồng bộ.");
                return;
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Bắt đầu đồng bộ nợ khó đòi...");
            var typeSync = await _syncJobService.GetLastIdAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            if (typeSync == null)
            {
                _logger.LogError("Không tìm thấy loại đồng bộ hóa {JobName}", JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
                return;
            }

            if (!long.TryParse(typeSync.LastIdSynced, out long lastId))
            {
                _logger.LogError("Không thể chuyển đổi LastIdSynced thành kiểu long.");
                return;
            }

            var job = await _syncJobService.StartJobAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            var total = await GetTotalRecordsAsync(lastId);

            if (total == 0)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Không có nợ khó đòi mới để đồng bộ.");
                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(job, duKien: 0, thucTe: 0);
                return;
            }
            await EnqueueBatchesAsync(job, lastId, total);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Truy vấn tổng số nợ khó đòi cần đồng bộ sau lastId.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<int> GetTotalRecordsAsync(long lastId)
        {
            var sql = SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetTotalNoKhoDoi;
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                sql, new { LastId = lastId },
                commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Chia dữ liệu thành các batch và enqueue background job để xử lý.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task EnqueueBatchesAsync(LichSuDongBo job, long lastId, int total)
        {
            int batchCount = (int)Math.Ceiling(total / (double)BatchSize);
            _logger.LogInformation("Tổng cộng {total} nợ khó đòi mới. Chia thành {batchCount} batch.", total, batchCount);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < batchCount; i++)
                {
                    int skip = i * BatchSize;
                    long chiTietId = await InsertBatchChiTietAsync(job.ID, skip, BatchSize, lastId);
                    var payload = new SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams
                    {
                        LastId = lastId,
                        Skip = skip,
                        Take = BatchSize,
                        MaJob = JobNames.NoKhoDoi,
                        JobId = job.ID,
                        ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                        Total = total,
                        TotalBatch = batchCount,
                        Index = i
                    };
                    _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
                }
                _logger.LogInformation("Đã đồng bộ {Count} nợ khó đòi.", total);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Lỗi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi: {Message}.", ex.Message);
                await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(job, ex.Message);
            }
            _logger.LogInformation("Đã enqueue toàn bộ {TotalBatch} batch.", batchCount);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Ghi log chi tiết một batch xử lý vào bảng lịch sử.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<long> InsertBatchChiTietAsync(long jobId, int skip, int take, long lastSyncedId = 0)
        {
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                SyncJobQueries.InsertBatchChiTiet,
                new
                {
                    JobId = jobId,
                    Skip = skip,
                    Take = take,
                    LastSyncedId = lastSyncedId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });
        }
    }
}

using WaterBilling.Application;
using WaterBilling.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using WaterBilling.Application.Utilities;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.HoaDon;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.ThanhToan;

namespace WaterBilling.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Provides extension methods to configure infrastructure services for the application.
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigureServices
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures infrastructure services such as database contexts and repositories.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection to which services will be added.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The application settings containing configuration values.</param>
    /// <returns>The updated service collection.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructuresService(this IServiceCollection services, AppSettings configuration)
    {
        services.AddMemoryCache();

        services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
        services.AddScoped<LocalizationService>();
        // Configure the database context based on the configuration
        if (configuration.AppConfigs.UseInMemoryDatabase)
        {
            // Use an in-memory database for development or testing
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseInMemoryDatabase("WaterBilling"));
        }
        else
        {
            // Use SQL Server with retry-on-failure for production
            services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseSqlServer(configuration.ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection,
                sqlOptions => sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3,
                                                              maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                                                              errorNumbersToAdd: null))
                                        .LogTo(Console.WriteLine, LogLevel.Information)
                                        .EnableSensitiveDataLogging()
             );
        }

        // 🟡 Thêm dòng sau ngay sau khi services được lấy:
        services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
        {
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncHoaDonBatchExecutor>();
            cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<SyncThanhToanBatchExecutor>();
        });

        // Register repository and unit of work services
        services.AddScoped<IUnitOfWork, UnitOfWork>();

        // Register the Dapper context
        services.AddScoped<IDapperContext, DapperContext>();

        services.AddScoped<IJobRegistryService, JobRegistryService>();

        return services;
    }
}

(

    Ky                  INT NULL,
    SoPhatHanh          BIGINT NOT NULL,

    TieuThu             BIGINT NULL,

    NgayThanhToan       DATETIME NULL,
    NgayGachNo          DATETIME NULL,
    NguoiGachNo         VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    NamChuyenNo         INT NULL
);
GO

PRINT N'TVP_NoKhoDoi created successfully.';

    @LastId BIGINT

BEGIN

    -- có SoPhatHanh > @LastId
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE SoPhatHanh > @LastId;
END

-- Script: 03_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql
-- Description: Stored procedure lấy dữ liệu nợ khó đòi từ nguồn
-- =============================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi
    @LastId BIGINT,
    @Skip   INT,
    @Take   INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Lấy dữ liệu nợ khó đòi từ nguồn (LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi)
    -- theo phân trang Skip/Take
    SELECT
        DanhBo,
        Nam,
        Ky,
        SoPhatHanh,
        SoHoaDon,
        TieuThu,
        TienNuoc,
        Thue,
        PhiBVMT,
        ThueDVTN,
        TongCong,
        DieuChinhTieuThu,
        DieuChinhTienNuoc,
        DieuChinhThue,
        DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
        DieuChinhThueDVTN,
        DieuChinhTongCong,
        NgayThanhToan,
        NgayGachNo,
        NguoiGachNo,
        NamChuyenNo
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE SoPhatHanh > @LastId
    ORDER BY SoPhatHanh
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;
END
GO

GO

-- =============================================
-- Script: 04_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge.sql
-- Description: Stored procedure MERGE nợ khó đòi vào bảng đích
-- =============================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge
    @Items dbo.TVP_NoKhoDoi READONLY
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Changed TABLE (Action NVARCHAR(10));

    -- MERGE: Update nếu đã tồn tại (theo SoPhatHanh), Insert nếu chưa có
    MERGE dbo.NoKhoDoi AS target
    USING @Items AS source
        ON target.SoPhatHanh = source.SoPhatHanh
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
            target.DanhBo = source.DanhBo,
            target.Nam = source.Nam,
            target.Ky = source.Ky,
            target.SoHoaDon = source.SoHoaDon,
            target.TieuThu = source.TieuThu,
            target.TienNuoc = source.TienNuoc,
            target.Thue = source.Thue,
            target.PhiBVMT = source.PhiBVMT,
            target.ThueDVTN = source.ThueDVTN,
            target.TongCong = source.TongCong,
            target.DieuChinhTieuThu = source.DieuChinhTieuThu,
            target.DieuChinhTienNuoc = source.DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            target.DieuChinhThue = source.DieuChinhThue,
            target.DieuChinhPhiBVMT = source.DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
            target.DieuChinhThueDVTN = source.DieuChinhThueDVTN,
            target.DieuChinhTongCong = source.DieuChinhTongCong,
            target.NgayThanhToan = source.NgayThanhToan,
            target.NgayGachNo = source.NgayGachNo,
            target.NguoiGachNo = source.NguoiGachNo,
            target.NamChuyenNo = source.NamChuyenNo
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (
            DanhBo, Nam, Ky, SoPhatHanh, SoHoaDon,
            TieuThu, TienNuoc, Thue, PhiBVMT, ThueDVTN,
            TongCong, DieuChinhTieuThu, DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            DieuChinhThue, DieuChinhPhiBVMT, DieuChinhThueDVTN,
            DieuChinhTongCong, NgayThanhToan, NgayGachNo,
            NguoiGachNo, NamChuyenNo
        )
        VALUES (
            source.DanhBo, source.Nam, source.Ky,
            source.SoPhatHanh, source.SoHoaDon,
            source.TieuThu, source.TienNuoc, source.Thue,
            source.PhiBVMT, source.ThueDVTN, source.TongCong,
            source.DieuChinhTieuThu, source.DieuChinhTienNuoc,
            source.DieuChinhThue, source.DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
            source.DieuChinhThueDVTN, source.DieuChinhTongCong,
            source.NgayThanhToan, source.NgayGachNo,
            source.NguoiGachNo, source.NamChuyenNo
        )
    OUTPUT $action INTO @Changed;

    -- Trả về số lượng bản ghi đã xử lý
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Changed;
END
GO

PRINT N'sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge created successfully.';
GO

        N'Đồng bộ dữ liệu nợ khó đòi từ hệ thống Billing', -- MoTa
        1,                                      -- TrangThai (1 = Active)
        GETDATE(),                              -- NgayTao
        '0'                                     -- LastIdSynced
    );
    PRINT N'Đã thêm loại đồng bộ no_kho_doi vào bảng LoaiDongBo.';
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    PRINT N'Loại đồng bộ no_kho_doi đã tồn tại.';
END

# Job Đồng Bộ Nợ Khó Đòi (NoKhoDoi)

## Mô tả

Job đồng bộ dữ liệu nợ khó đòi từ database nguồn `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi` về hệ thống WaterBilling.

## Thông tin cấu hình

| Thuộc tính | Giá trị |
|------------|---------|
| **Mã job** | `no_kho_doi` |
| **Tần suất** | `0 0 2 * * ?` (2h sáng mỗi ngày) |
| **Batch size** | 5000 records/batch |

## Cấu trúc bảng nguồn

**Database:** `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| DanhBo | varchar(11) | Mã danh bộ khách hàng |
| Nam | int | Năm |
| Ky | int | Kỳ |
| SoPhatHanh | bigint | Số phát hành (Primary Key) |
| SoHoaDon | varchar(20) | Số hóa đơn |
| TieuThu | bigint | Tiêu thụ |
| TienNuoc | bigint | Tiền nước |
| Thue | bigint | Thuế |
| PhiBVMT | bigint | Phí bảo vệ môi trường |
| ThueDVTN | bigint | Thuế dịch vụ thoát nước |
| TongCong | bigint | Tổng cộng |
| DieuChinhTieuThu | bigint | Điều chỉnh tiêu thụ |
| DieuChinhTienNuoc | bigint | Điều chỉnh tiền nước |
| DieuChinhThue | bigint | Điều chỉnh thuế |
| DieuChinhPhiBVMT | bigint | Điều chỉnh phí BVMT |
| DieuChinhThueDVTN | bigint | Điều chỉnh thuế DVTN |
| DieuChinhTongCong | bigint | Điều chỉnh tổng cộng |
| NgayThanhToan | datetime | Ngày thanh toán |
| NgayGachNo | datetime | Ngày gạch nợ |
| NguoiGachNo | varchar(20) | Người gạch nợ |
| NamChuyenNo | int | Năm chuyển nợ |

## Kiến trúc

```
SyncNoKhoDoiJob (Hangfire RecurringJob)
    │
    ├── Kiểm tra batch đang chạy (IsAnyBatchPendingAsync)
    │
    ├── Lấy LastIdSynced từ LoaiDongBo
    │
    ├── Đếm tổng số records cần sync (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi)
    │
    └── Chia thành các batch và enqueue
            │
            └── SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor (Background Job)
                    │
                    └── SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler (MediatR)
                            │
                            ├── Lấy data từ nguồn (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi)
                            │
                            ├── MERGE vào bảng đích (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge)
                            │
                            └── Cập nhật LichSuDongBo/LichSuDongBoChiTiet
```

## Các file liên quan

### Application Layer
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Commands/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchCommand.cs`
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Handlers/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler.cs`

### Infrastructure Layer
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Interfaces/ISyncNoKhoDoiJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Interfaces/ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Params/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/SqlQueries/SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Constants/JobNames.cs` (thêm `NoKhoDoi = "no_kho_doi"`)

### SQL Scripts
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/01_create_tvp_no_kho_doi.sql` - TVP cho bulk insert
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/02_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi.sql` - Đếm records
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/03_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql` - Lấy data từ nguồn
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/04_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge.sql` - MERGE vào đích
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/05_insert_loai_dong_bo.sql` - Insert LoaiDongBo

## Cài đặt

1. Chạy các SQL scripts theo thứ tự trong folder `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/`
2. Đảm bảo Linked Server `LINK45` đã được cấu hình và có quyền truy cập `Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`
3. Restart ứng dụng để đăng ký job với Hangfire

## Retry Logic

- Khi batch thất bại, hệ thống sẽ ghi nhận vào `LichSuDongBoChiTiet` với trạng thái `that_bai`
- Có thể retry job qua API hoặc Hangfire Dashboard
- Retry sẽ chỉ xử lý lại các batch chưa hoàn thành

# Bad Debt Sync Job (NoKhoDoi)

## Description

Background job to synchronize bad debt data from source database `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi` to the WaterBilling system.

## Configuration

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Job Code** | `no_kho_doi` |
| **Schedule** | `0 0 2 * * ?` (Daily at 2:00 AM) |
| **Batch Size** | 5000 records/batch |

## Source Table Structure

**Database:** `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| DanhBo | varchar(11) | Customer code |
| Nam | int | Year |
| Ky | int | Period |
| SoPhatHanh | bigint | Issue number (Primary Key) |
| SoHoaDon | varchar(20) | Invoice number |
| TieuThu | bigint | Consumption |
| TienNuoc | bigint | Water fee |
| Thue | bigint | Tax |
| PhiBVMT | bigint | Environmental protection fee |
| ThueDVTN | bigint | Drainage service tax |
| TongCong | bigint | Total amount |
| DieuChinhTieuThu | bigint | Consumption adjustment |
| DieuChinhTienNuoc | bigint | Water fee adjustment |
| DieuChinhThue | bigint | Tax adjustment |
| DieuChinhPhiBVMT | bigint | Environmental fee adjustment |
| DieuChinhThueDVTN | bigint | Drainage tax adjustment |
| DieuChinhTongCong | bigint | Total adjustment |
| NgayThanhToan | datetime | Payment date |
| NgayGachNo | datetime | Debt clearance date |
| NguoiGachNo | varchar(20) | Debt cleared by |
| NamChuyenNo | int | Debt transfer year |

## Architecture

```
SyncNoKhoDoiJob (Hangfire RecurringJob)
    |
    +-- Check for running batches (IsAnyBatchPendingAsync)
    |
    +-- Get LastIdSynced from LoaiDongBo
    |
    +-- Count total records to sync (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi)
    |
    +-- Split into batches and enqueue
            |
            +-- SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor (Background Job)
                    |
                    +-- SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler (MediatR)
                            |
                            +-- Fetch data from source (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi)
                            |
                            +-- MERGE into target table (sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge)
                            |
                            +-- Update LichSuDongBo/LichSuDongBoChiTiet
```

## Related Files

### Application Layer
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Commands/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchCommand.cs`
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Handlers/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler.cs`

### Infrastructure Layer
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Interfaces/ISyncNoKhoDoiJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Interfaces/ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Params/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/SqlQueries/SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Constants/JobNames.cs` (added `NoKhoDoi = "no_kho_doi"`)

### SQL Scripts
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/01_create_tvp_no_kho_doi.sql` - TVP for bulk insert
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/02_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi.sql` - Count records
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/03_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql` - Fetch data from source
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/04_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge.sql` - MERGE into target
- `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/05_insert_loai_dong_bo.sql` - Insert LoaiDongBo record

## Installation

1. Run SQL scripts in order from `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/` folder
2. Ensure Linked Server `LINK45` is configured with access to `Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`
3. Restart the application to register the job with Hangfire

## Retry Logic

- When a batch fails, the system records it in `LichSuDongBoChiTiet` with status `that_bai`
- Jobs can be retried via API or Hangfire Dashboard
- Retry will only process incomplete batches

Có 2 cách tiếp cận:


Cách 1: Lấy bản ghi mới nhất theo DanhBo (theo Nam, Ky)


-- Cập nhật sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi để chỉ lấy record mới nhất per DanhBo
WITH RankedData AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY DanhBo 
            ORDER BY Nam DESC, Ky DESC, SoPhatHanh DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE SoPhatHanh > @LastId
)
SELECT DanhBo, Nam, Ky, SoPhatHanh, SoHoaDon, ...
FROM RankedData
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY SoPhatHanh
OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;

The user is pointing out that based on the example data in the documentation, the query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi] WHERE SoPhatHanh > @LastId won't get the "latest" records correctly.

    • 

  • The data shows records from different years (2019-2023)
    • 

  • The highest SoPhatHanh (19132146) is from 2022, not the most recent year
    • 



The issue is that SoPhatHanh is NOT an auto-increment ID that represents chronological order. Looking at the data:


    

  • SoPhatHanh 19132146 is for year 2022
    • 

  • SoPhatHanh 18061908 is for year 2023
    • 



So SoPhatHanh doesn't correlate with the actual date/year of the debt. Using SoPhatHanh > @LastId won't correctly identify "new" records.


The user is right - we need a different approach. Options:


    

  1. Use a different column to track sync (like a created date or modified date if available)
    2. 

  2. Sync ALL records and use MERGE to update existing ones
    3. 

  3. Add a timestamp column to track when records were added
    4. 



Looking at the source table structure, there's no obvious "created date" column. The columns available are:


    

  • NgayThanhToan (Payment date) - can be NULL
    • 

  • NgayGachNo (Debt clearance date) - can be NULL
    • 

  • NamChuyenNo (Debt transfer year)
    • 



Since there's no reliable incremental ID or created timestamp, the best approach might be:


    

  1. Do a full sync periodically (not incremental)
    2. 

  2. Or add a filter based on NamChuyenNo (debt transfer year) to only sync recent years
    3.

# Bad Debt Sync Job (NoKhoDoi)

## Description

Background job to synchronize bad debt data from source database `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi` to the WaterBilling system.

**Sync Strategy:** Full sync with MERGE - fetches all records from source and uses MERGE to update existing or insert new records based on `SoPhatHanh` as the key.

-- Description: Count bad debt records for DAILY sync by NgayGachNo
-- =============================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi
    @LastId BIGINT  -- LastId = last NgayGachNo as YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20241231)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @LastDate DATE;

    -- Convert YYYYMMDD to DATE
    IF @LastId > 0
        SET @LastDate = CONVERT(DATE, CAST(@LastId AS VARCHAR(8)), 112);
    ELSE
        SET @LastDate = '1900-01-01';

    -- Count records where NgayGachNo > last synced date
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE NgayGachNo > @LastDate;
END
GO

PRINT N'sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi created successfully.';
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi
    @LastId BIGINT,  -- LastId = last NgayGachNo as YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20241231)
    @Skip   INT,
    @Take   INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @LastDate DATE;

    -- Convert YYYYMMDD to DATE
    IF @LastId > 0
        SET @LastDate = CONVERT(DATE, CAST(@LastId AS VARCHAR(8)), 112);
    ELSE
        SET @LastDate = '1900-01-01';

    -- Fetch records where NgayGachNo > last synced date
    SELECT
        DanhBo,
        Nam,
        Ky,
        SoPhatHanh,
        SoHoaDon,
        TieuThu,
        TienNuoc,
        Thue,
        PhiBVMT,
        ThueDVTN,
        TongCong,
        DieuChinhTieuThu,
        DieuChinhTienNuoc,
        DieuChinhThue,
        DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
        DieuChinhThueDVTN,
        DieuChinhTongCong,
        NgayThanhToan,
        NgayGachNo,
        NguoiGachNo,
        NamChuyenNo
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE NgayGachNo > @LastDate
    ORDER BY NgayGachNo, SoPhatHanh
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;
END
GO

    /// <summary>
    /// Parameters for yearly bad debt sync batch by NamChuyenNo.

    public class SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchParams
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Last NamChuyenNo synced (e.g., 2023).

        public long LastId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>
        /// Job code: "no_kho_doi_nam".

        /// Batch detail ID (LichSuDongBoChiTiet.ID).

        /// <summary>
        /// Total records to process.
        /// </summary>
        public int Total { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Total batches for this job.
        /// </summary>
        public int TotalBatch { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Current batch index (starts from 0).
        /// </summary>
        public int Index { get; set; }
    }

using Dapper;
using MediatR;
using System.Data;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using Application.NoKhoDoi.Commands;

namespace Application.NoKhoDoi.Handlers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handler for yearly bad debt sync by NamChuyenNo.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommand, int>
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _appConn;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;

        public SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommandHandler(
            IDapperContext appConn,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _appConn = appConn;
            _logger = logger;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
        }

        public async Task<int> Handle(SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var data = request.data;
            var affected = 0;
            try
            {
                // 1. Fetch bad debt records by NamChuyenNo
                var batch = (await _appConn.Connection.QueryAsync<SyncNoKhoDoiDTO>(
                    SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetNoKhoDoiNamSql,
                    new { LastId = data.LastId, Skip = data.Skip, Take = data.Take },
                    commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                    commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout
                )).ToList();

                if (batch.Count == 0)
                {
                    await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                        data.JobId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                        data.ChiTietId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                        0,
                        data.Total);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 2. Merge into target table
                    var dtBatch = ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(batch);
                    affected = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                        SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.MergeNoKhoDoiSql,
                        new
                        {
                            Items = dtBatch.AsTableValuedParameter("dbo.TVP_NoKhoDoi")
                        },
                        commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);

                    await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                        data.JobId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                        data.ChiTietId,
                        ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh,
                        affected,
                        data.Total);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error syncing yearly bad debt batch: {Message}", ex.Message);

                await UpdateJobStatusAsync(
                    data.JobId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy,
                    data.ChiTietId,
                    ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai,
                    0,
                    data.Total,
                    ex.Message);
            }

            // 3. Check remaining batches
            int remaining = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                SyncJobQueries.CheckJobRunning,
                new
                {
                    JobId = data.JobId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });

            // 4. Finalize job if all batches complete
            if (remaining == 0)
            {
                int total = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                    SyncJobQueries.SumSoLuongBatchTheoTrangThai,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.HoanThanh });

                var failedBatch = await _appConn.Connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<LichSuDongBoChiTiet?>(
                    SyncJobQueries.GetFailedBatFirst,
                    new { JobId = data.JobId, TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.ThatBai });

                if (failedBatch != null)
                {
                    await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(data.JobId, "");
                }
                else
                {
                    // Update LastIdSynced to max NamChuyenNo
                    long lastId = await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                        SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetMaxNoKhoDoiNam,
                        new { LastId = data.LastId });

                    await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                        SyncJobQueries.UpdateLoaiDongBo,
                        new { Ma = data.MaJob, LastId = lastId });
                }

                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(data.JobId, total);
            }

            return affected;
        }

        private async Task UpdateJobStatusAsync(
            long jobId,
            string trangThaiJob,
            long chiTietId,
            string trangThaiBatch,
            int soLuong,
            int duKien,
            string ghiChu = "")
        {
            await _appConn.Connection.ExecuteAsync(
                SyncJobQueries.UpdateLichSuDongBo,
                new
                {
                    TrangThai = trangThaiBatch,
                    ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                    JobId = jobId,
                    SoLuong = soLuong,
                    TrangThaiJob = trangThaiJob,
                    DuKien = duKien,
                    GhiChu = ghiChu
                });
        }

        private DataTable ToNoKhoDoiDataTable(List<SyncNoKhoDoiDTO> batch)
        {
            var dt = new DataTable();
            dt.Columns.Add("DanhBo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("Nam", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("Ky", typeof(int));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoPhatHanh", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("SoHoaDon", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("TieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("Thue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("PhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("ThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("TongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTieuThu", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTienNuoc", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThue", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhPhiBVMT", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhThueDVTN", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("DieuChinhTongCong", typeof(long));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayThanhToan", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NgayGachNo", typeof(DateTime));
            dt.Columns.Add("NguoiGachNo", typeof(string));
            dt.Columns.Add("NamChuyenNo", typeof(int));

            foreach (var item in batch)
            {
                dt.Rows.Add(
                    item.DanhBo,
                    (object?)item.Nam ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.Ky ?? DBNull.Value,
                    item.SoPhatHanh,
                    item.SoHoaDon,
                    (object?)item.TieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.Thue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.PhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.ThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.TongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTieuThu ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTienNuoc ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThue ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhPhiBVMT ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhThueDVTN ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.DieuChinhTongCong ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayThanhToan ?? DBNull.Value,
                    (object?)item.NgayGachNo ?? DBNull.Value,
                    item.NguoiGachNo,
                    (object?)item.NamChuyenNo ?? DBNull.Value
                );
            }

            return dt;
        }
    }
}

using MediatR;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using Application.NoKhoDoi.Commands;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executor for yearly bad debt sync batch.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor : ISyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor
    {
        private readonly ISender _sender;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor> _logger;

        public SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor(ISender sender, ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor> logger)
        {
            _sender = sender;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task ExecuteSkipTake(SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchParams data)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("NoKhoDoi yearly batch info {data}", data);
            var result = await _sender.Send(new SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommand(data));
            _logger.LogInformation("Processed yearly bad debt batch {data} => {result} records", data, result);
        }
    }
}

using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Dapper;
using Hangfire;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using System.Data;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Yearly bad debt sync job by NamChuyenNo.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiNamJob : ISyncNoKhoDoiNamJob
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _dapperContext;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamJob> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;
        private const int BatchSize = 5000;

        public SyncNoKhoDoiNamJob(
            IDapperContext dapperContext,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiNamJob> logger,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient)
        {
            _dapperContext = dapperContext;
            _logger = logger;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
            _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
        }

        public async Task Run(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var isPending = await _syncJobService.IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoiNam);
            if (isPending)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Yearly bad debt batch still running. Skipping.");
                return;
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Starting yearly bad debt sync...");
            var typeSync = await _syncJobService.GetLastIdAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoiNam);
            if (typeSync == null)
            {
                _logger.LogError("Sync type not found: {JobName}", JobNames.NoKhoDoiNam);
                return;
            }

            if (!long.TryParse(typeSync.LastIdSynced, out long lastId))
            {
                _logger.LogError("Cannot parse LastIdSynced to long.");
                return;
            }

            var job = await _syncJobService.StartJobAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoiNam);
            var total = await GetTotalRecordsAsync(lastId);

            if (total == 0)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("No new yearly bad debt records to sync.");
                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(job, duKien: 0, thucTe: 0);
                return;
            }
            await EnqueueBatchesAsync(job, lastId, total);
        }

        private async Task<int> GetTotalRecordsAsync(long lastId)
        {
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetTotalNoKhoDoiNam,
                new { LastId = lastId },
                commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);
        }

        private async Task EnqueueBatchesAsync(LichSuDongBo job, long lastId, int total)
        {
            int batchCount = (int)Math.Ceiling(total / (double)BatchSize);
            _logger.LogInformation("Total {total} yearly bad debt records. Splitting into {batchCount} batches.", total, batchCount);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < batchCount; i++)
                {
                    int skip = i * BatchSize;
                    long chiTietId = await InsertBatchChiTietAsync(job.ID, skip, BatchSize, lastId);
                    var payload = new SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchParams
                    {
                        LastId = lastId,
                        Skip = skip,
                        Take = BatchSize,
                        MaJob = JobNames.NoKhoDoiNam,
                        JobId = job.ID,
                        ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                        Total = total,
                        TotalBatch = batchCount,
                        Index = i
                    };
                    _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
                }
                _logger.LogInformation("Synced {Count} yearly bad debt records.", total);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError("Error syncing yearly bad debt: {Message}.", ex.Message);
                await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(job, ex.Message);
            }
            _logger.LogInformation("Enqueued {TotalBatch} batches.", batchCount);
        }

        private async Task<long> InsertBatchChiTietAsync(long jobId, int skip, int take, long lastSyncedId = 0)
        {
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                SyncJobQueries.InsertBatchChiTiet,
                new
                {
                    JobId = jobId,
                    Skip = skip,
                    Take = take,
                    LastSyncedId = lastSyncedId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });
        }
    }
}

-- Script: 05_insert_loai_dong_bo.sql
-- Description: Insert bad debt sync job types into LoaiDongBo
-- =============================================

-- Daily job: Sync by NgayGachNo
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.LoaiDongBo WHERE Ma = 'no_kho_doi')
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO dbo.LoaiDongBo (Ma, Ten, TanSuat, MoTa, TrangThai, NgayTao, LastIdSynced)
    VALUES (
        'no_kho_doi',
        N'Bad Debt Daily Sync',
        '0 0 2 * * ?',                          -- Cron: Daily at 2:00 AM
        N'Daily sync bad debt by NgayGachNo (debt clearance date)',
        1,                                      -- Active
        GETDATE(),
        '0'                                     -- LastIdSynced = 0 (YYYYMMDD format)
    );
    PRINT N'Added no_kho_doi to LoaiDongBo.';
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    PRINT N'no_kho_doi already exists.';
END
GO

-- Yearly job: Sync by NamChuyenNo
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.LoaiDongBo WHERE Ma = 'no_kho_doi_nam')
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO dbo.LoaiDongBo (Ma, Ten, TanSuat, MoTa, TrangThai, NgayTao, LastIdSynced)
    VALUES (
        'no_kho_doi_nam',
        N'Bad Debt Yearly Sync',
        '0 0 3 1 1 ?',                          -- Cron: Jan 1st at 3:00 AM
        N'Yearly sync bad debt by NamChuyenNo (debt transfer year)',
        1,                                      -- Active
        GETDATE(),
        '2022'                                  -- LastIdSynced = last year synced
    );
    PRINT N'Added no_kho_doi_nam to LoaiDongBo.';
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    PRINT N'no_kho_doi_nam already exists.';
END
GO

# Bad Debt Sync Jobs (NoKhoDoi)

## Overview

Two jobs to synchronize bad debt data from `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`:

| Job | Code | Schedule | Sync By | Description |
|-----|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Daily** | `no_kho_doi` | 2:00 AM daily | `NgayGachNo` | Syncs newly cleared debts |
| **Yearly** | `no_kho_doi_nam` | Jan 1st 3:00 AM | `NamChuyenNo` | Syncs debts by transfer year |

## Daily Job (`no_kho_doi`)

Syncs bad debt records based on **NgayGachNo** (debt clearance date).

- **LastIdSynced format**: `YYYYMMDD` (e.g., `20241231`)
- **Use case**: Capture debts cleared since last sync

```sql
WHERE NgayGachNo > @LastDate
ORDER BY NgayGachNo, SoPhatHanh
```

## Yearly Job (`no_kho_doi_nam`)

Syncs bad debt records based on **NamChuyenNo** (debt transfer year).

- **LastIdSynced format**: Year (e.g., `2023`)
- **Use case**: Sync all debts from new transfer years

```sql
WHERE NamChuyenNo > @LastId
ORDER BY NamChuyenNo, SoPhatHanh
```

## Source Table Structure

**Database:** `LINK45.Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| DanhBo | varchar(11) | Customer code |
| Nam | int | Year |
| Ky | int | Period |
| SoPhatHanh | bigint | Issue number (Primary Key for MERGE) |
| SoHoaDon | varchar(20) | Invoice number |
| TieuThu | bigint | Consumption |
| TienNuoc | bigint | Water fee |
| Thue | bigint | Tax |
| PhiBVMT | bigint | Environmental protection fee |
| ThueDVTN | bigint | Drainage service tax |
| TongCong | bigint | Total amount |
| NgayGachNo | datetime | **Debt clearance date** (used by daily job) |
| NamChuyenNo | int | **Debt transfer year** (used by yearly job) |

## Architecture

```
Job (Hangfire RecurringJob)
    |
    +-- Check for running batches
    |
    +-- Get LastIdSynced from LoaiDongBo
    |
    +-- Count records to sync (stored procedure)
    |
    +-- Split into batches (5000 records each)
            |
            +-- BatchExecutor (Background Job)
                    |
                    +-- CommandHandler (MediatR)
                            |
                            +-- Fetch from source (stored procedure)
                            |
                            +-- MERGE into target (by SoPhatHanh)
                            |
                            +-- Update sync history
```

## SQL Scripts

Run in order from `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/`:

| # | File | Description |
|---|------|-------------|
| 1 | `01_create_tvp_no_kho_doi.sql` | Create TVP for bulk insert |
| 2 | `02_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi.sql` | Count records (daily) |
| 3 | `03_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql` | Fetch records (daily) |
| 4 | `04_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiMerge.sql` | MERGE into target |
| 5 | `05_insert_loai_dong_bo.sql` | Insert job configs |
| 6 | `06_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiNamSoLuong.sql` | Count records (yearly) |
| 7 | `07_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiNamGetMoi.sql` | Fetch records (yearly) |

## Related Files

### Daily Job
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Handlers/SyncNoKhoDoiBatchDataCommandHandler.cs`

### Yearly Job
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiNamJob.cs`
- `src/Infrastructure/Jobs/Handlers/NoKhoDoi/SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchExecutor.cs`
- `src/Application/Features/NoKhoDoi/Handlers/SyncNoKhoDoiNamBatchDataCommandHandler.cs`

## Installation

1. Run SQL scripts in order from `scripts/sync_no_kho_doi/`
2. Ensure Linked Server `LINK45` has access to `Billing.dbo.NoKhoDoi`
3. Restart application to register jobs with Hangfire

## Retry Logic

- Failed batches are recorded in `LichSuDongBoChiTiet` with status `that_bai`
- Retry via API or Hangfire Dashboard
- Only incomplete batches are reprocessed

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi
    @LastId BIGINT  -- LastId = last NgayGachNo as YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20241231)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @LastDate DATE;

    -- Convert YYYYMMDD to DATE
    IF @LastId > 0
        SET @LastDate = CONVERT(DATE, CAST(@LastId AS VARCHAR(8)), 112);
    ELSE
        SET @LastDate = '1900-01-01';

    -- Count records where NgayGachNo > last synced date
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE NgayGachNo > @LastDate;
END
GO

PRINT N'sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiSoLuongMoi created successfully.';
GO

-- =============================================
-- Script: 03_sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi.sql
-- Description: Fetch bad debt records for DAILY sync by NgayGachNo
-- =============================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi
    @LastId BIGINT,  -- LastId = last NgayGachNo as YYYYMMDD format (e.g., 20241231)
    @Skip   INT,
    @Take   INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @LastDate DATE;

    -- Convert YYYYMMDD to DATE
    IF @LastId > 0
        SET @LastDate = CONVERT(DATE, CAST(@LastId AS VARCHAR(8)), 112);
    ELSE
        SET @LastDate = '1900-01-01';

    -- Fetch records where NgayGachNo > last synced date
    SELECT
        DanhBo,
        Nam,
        Ky,
        SoPhatHanh,
        SoHoaDon,
        TieuThu,
        TienNuoc,
        Thue,
        PhiBVMT,
        ThueDVTN,
        TongCong,
        DieuChinhTieuThu,
        DieuChinhTienNuoc,
        DieuChinhThue,
        DieuChinhPhiBVMT,
        DieuChinhThueDVTN,
        DieuChinhTongCong,
        NgayThanhToan,
        NgayGachNo,
        NguoiGachNo,
        NamChuyenNo
    FROM [LINK45].[Billing].[dbo].[NoKhoDoi]
    WHERE NgayGachNo > @LastDate
    ORDER BY NgayGachNo, SoPhatHanh
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;
END
GO

PRINT N'sp_DongBoNoKhoDoiGetMoi created successfully.';
GO

using Infrastructure.Jobs.Interfaces;
using WaterBilling.Application.Interfaces;
using Infrastructure.Constants;
using Infrastructure.Data;
using Dapper;
using Hangfire;
using WaterBilling.Domain.Constants;
using Infrastructure.SqlQueries;
using Infrastructure.Jobs.Params;
using WaterBilling.Application;
using System.Data;

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Handlers.NoKhoDoi
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Job đồng bộ nợ khó đòi từ hệ thống Billing.
    /// </summary>
    public class SyncNoKhoDoiJob : ISyncNoKhoDoiJob
    {
        private readonly IDapperContext _dapperContext;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiJob> _logger;
        private readonly ISyncJobService _syncJobService;
        private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient;
        private readonly AppSettings _appSettings;
        private const int BatchSize = 5000;

        /// <summary>
        /// Hàm khởi tạo job đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        public SyncNoKhoDoiJob(
            IDapperContext dapperContext,
            ISyncJobService syncJobService,
            ILogger<SyncNoKhoDoiJob> logger,
            AppSettings appSettings,
            IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient)
        {
            _dapperContext = dapperContext;
            _logger = logger;
            _syncJobService = syncJobService;
            _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Thực thi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Token hủy bỏ</param>
        public async Task Run(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Kiểm tra nếu còn batch chưa hoàn tất
            var isPending = await _syncJobService.IsAnyBatchPendingAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            if (isPending)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Đang có batch nợ khó đòi chưa hoàn tất. Dừng đồng bộ.");
                return;
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Bắt đầu đồng bộ nợ khó đòi...");
            var typeSync = await _syncJobService.GetLastIdAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            if (typeSync == null)
            {
                _logger.LogError("Không tìm thấy loại đồng bộ hóa {JobName}", JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
                return;
            }

            if (!long.TryParse(typeSync.LastIdSynced, out long lastId))
            {
                _logger.LogError("Không thể chuyển đổi LastIdSynced thành kiểu long.");
                return;
            }

            var job = await _syncJobService.StartJobAsync(JobNames.NoKhoDoi);
            var total = await GetTotalRecordsAsync(lastId);

            if (total == 0)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Không có nợ khó đòi mới để đồng bộ.");
                await _syncJobService.CompleteJobAsync(job, duKien: 0, thucTe: 0);
                return;
            }
            await EnqueueBatchesAsync(job, lastId, total);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Truy vấn tổng số nợ khó đòi cần đồng bộ sau lastId.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<int> GetTotalRecordsAsync(long lastId)
        {
            var sql = SyncNoKhoDoiQueries.GetTotalNoKhoDoi;
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(
                sql, new { LastId = lastId },
                commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure,
                commandTimeout: _appSettings.AppConfigs.CommandTimeout);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Chia dữ liệu thành các batch và enqueue background job để xử lý.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task EnqueueBatchesAsync(LichSuDongBo job, long lastId, int total)
        {
            int batchCount = (int)Math.Ceiling(total / (double)BatchSize);
            _logger.LogInformation("Tổng cộng {total} nợ khó đòi mới. Chia thành {batchCount} batch.", total, batchCount);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < batchCount; i++)
                {
                    int skip = i * BatchSize;
                    long chiTietId = await InsertBatchChiTietAsync(job.ID, skip, BatchSize, lastId);
                    var payload = new SyncNoKhoDoiBatchParams
                    {
                        LastId = lastId,
                        Skip = skip,
                        Take = BatchSize,
                        MaJob = JobNames.NoKhoDoi,
                        JobId = job.ID,
                        ChiTietId = chiTietId,
                        Total = total,
                        TotalBatch = batchCount,
                        Index = i
                    };
                    _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ISyncNoKhoDoiBatchExecutor>(x => x.ExecuteSkipTake(payload));
                }
                _logger.LogInformation("Đã đồng bộ {Count} nợ khó đòi.", total);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Lỗi đồng bộ nợ khó đòi: {Message}.", ex.Message);
                await _syncJobService.FailJobAsync(job, ex.Message);
            }
            _logger.LogInformation("Đã enqueue toàn bộ {TotalBatch} batch.", batchCount);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Ghi log chi tiết một batch xử lý vào bảng lịch sử.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<long> InsertBatchChiTietAsync(long jobId, int skip, int take, long lastSyncedId = 0)
        {
            return await _dapperContext.Connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
                SyncJobQueries.InsertBatchChiTiet,
                new
                {
                    JobId = jobId,
                    Skip = skip,
                    Take = take,
                    LastSyncedId = lastSyncedId,
                    TrangThai = ApplicationConstants.TrangThaiDongBo.DangXuLy
                });
        }
    }
}

namespace Infrastructure.Jobs.Params

    /// <summary>
